title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.
  
Oversee the deployment, commissioning, and configuration of digital infrastructure
  
Configure and operate servers, storage, backup systems, datacenter support functions, as well as virtualization environments (both on-premises and in the cloud).
  
Work closely with team members and vendors to design digital infrastructure and implement best practices.
  
Define operational processes for monitoring and maintaining infrastructure, ensuring secure, efficient, and reliable operations.
  
Develop plans for maintenance and support to minimize downtime and ensure smooth operations.
  
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, prioritize infrastructure requirements, and ensure the safe and robust platform while improving productivity, safety, and sustainability in the factory.
  
Create and document best practices, and mentor team members to foster growth and improve infrastructure operations.
  
Participate in an on-call rotation together with other team members to support the 24/7 operation of critical infrastructure.
  
  

What you’ll bring
  
We’re seeking someone with a proactive and collaborative mindset who thrives in a dynamic environment. You excel at problem-solving, organization, and clear communication, especially when explaining technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders. Empathy for end-users and a passion for creating technology that improves their daily work are key traits we value.
  
Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below
  
A University degree or equivalent experience, Bachelor or Master’s in Engineering or Computer Science.
  
Relevant experience in datacenter operations.
  
Hands-on experience with configuring and managing virtualization environments such as VMware / Nutanix.
  
Hands-on experience in Infrastructure provisioning and configuration management via infrastructure as code (IaC) – Ansible / Terraform.
  
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for Containers management, deployment and scaling.
  
Knowledge of Cybersecurity best practices, and experience in analyzing possible threats and vulnerabilities, embedding security standards, monitoring adherence to them, and implementing disaster recovery plans.
  
Experience with Active Directory and Users management systems.
  
Very good experience with AWS services configuration and management.
  
Experience with performance monitoring and troubleshooting for hosts, servers, databases, virtual machines, containers.
  
Good knowledge of networks and network protocols.
  
Experience with Data Backup solutions.
  
Experience with administration of Linux and Windows based systems
  
Experience in writing scripts with at least one scripting language - such as Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.
  
Experience with OT infrastructure such as Historians, HMI, Scada, Edge gateways.
  
Experience with Agile and DevOps methodologies, and with Continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) platforms.

title: Site Reliability Engineer – Data & Analytics at SEB in Stockholm
description:
*SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?*



Our tribe Data and Analytics lead all parts of SEB in becoming a data driven company, and we are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen our team in Stockholm working in the area of large-scale data solutions

  




**About the job**



You will be part of our Data & AI Platform Foundation team with the mission to provide a future-proof, reliable and efficient data platform for SEB. Together with your colleagues you will be responsible for building platform services that support , batch processing and operations, workflow automation and orchestration, monitoring, hybrid cloud integration with GCP and much more. Everything with security and automation in mind. You will have the opportunity to broaden your competence and will be given a generous amount of time for your own ideas and projects.



We belong to the SEB Data & Analytics tribe, an international environment with multiple agile development teams located in Stockholm and Vilnius, consisting of experts in various Big Data technologies.

  




**Who are you?**  

In order to thrive here you should be interested in data engineering and like finding creative solutions to complex problems. If you are analytical, curious and have a passion for discovering new ways of working, you will enjoy it here.

  




Required skills



* Experience from working in Linux environments.
* Cloud engineering experience.
* Programming and scripting skills (e.g. bash, python)
* An automation, DevOps, SRE mindset.
* Collaboration skills and high sense of responsibility. We are working team/squad based, and the ability to share knowledge and experience is fundamental.

  


Nice-to-have



* Version control systems (e.g. Git)
* Database knowledge (e.g. SQL, NoSQL)
* Experience from working with container orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift) and Terraform
* Experience with monitoring, metrics and log management systems (e.g. Zabbix, Grafana, Splunk)
* Knowledge of authentication and authorization services (e.g. Kerberos, LDAP, OAuth 2.0)
* Automation and configuration management systems (e.g. Ansible, Terraform, Chef)
* CI/CD, such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins
Learn more about working at SEB www.sebgroup.com/career  

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.



Great people often know great people, please share if you have a friend who would love this job.

  




**Welcome with your application**



Attach your CV and a personal letter describing yourself and how you can contribute to our journey. Since we select candidates on running bases, feel free to send in your application today, but no later than **2026-09-01**. If you have questions about the position, please contact hiring manager: Nikola Rajkovic, nikola.rajkovic@seb.se. SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.



It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Modulai works with fish, trains, clothes, money, pets, office spaces, sound sensors and much more. If there is data, we do ML (Machine Learning) on it.
  
Our team consists of devoted ML engineers with strong track records from some of Sweden’s most successful startups. We work on project basis and take end-to-end responsibility. We love ML and we think that the best way for us to expand our knowledge is to be exposed to a diversified set of challenging and fun projects.
  
MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER
  
As a member of the ML-team you will be working with a broad range of problems with one common denominator – ML will be the key ingredient. The projects could be external as well as internal – and in all cases – delivery is central.
  
You will have to analyze the problem at hand, come up with a solution strategy and execute on it. This typically entails gaining an in-depth understanding of the challenge, understanding the available data and then re-formulating it as a ML problem. It requires openness, creativity and an eagerness to learn new methodology and exploring new terrains.
  
We frequently attack these problems as a team, meaning that you will have to be able to clearly explain your reasoning and code in order to engage the rest of us.
  
  

Our Stack
  
Python / R – standard open-source libraries
  
Scikit-learn and various specialized Python and R ML libraries
  
Large Language Model (LLM) frameworks such as LangChain/LlamaIndex, LangGraph, CrewAI
  
Cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure
  
**CI/CD:** DVC, Github Actions, Sagemaker/VertexAI/AzureML,
  
Relational database management systems
  
MLOps and LLMOps tools for model deployment and monitoring.
  
Software engineering best practices, including testing, version control (Git), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  
**Orchestration:** Airflow, AWS Step functions, etc Engineering/LLM/deployment: Kubernetes, docker, terraform
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Analyzing and planning problems, solutions, and delivery with stakeholder managment, and communication with client
  
Preprocessing, feature engineering, and dataset creation
  
ML and LLM model development, fine-tuning, and evaluation
  
Validation of results and model interpretability
  
Building and optimizing data pipelines and ML/LLM infrastructure
  
Developing APIs and integrating ML models into production systems
  
Ensuring scalability, monitoring, and performance optimization of deployed models
  
  

Background & Skills
  
MSc or Ph.D. in a quantitative field
  
Excellent understanding of a broad set of ML and deep learning algorithms, including LLMs
  
Strong software development skills in Python and experience with software engineering best practices
  
Experience deploying ML and LLM models into production environments
  
A passion for lean, clean, and maintainable code
  
The desire to grow and to share insights with others
  
  

Helpful Knowledge
  
Deep learning frameworks and transformer-based architectures
  
LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
  
Data pipelining and ML/LLM infrastructure best practices
  
DevOps experience, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and serverless architectures
  
Experience with vector databases e.g (Pinecode, redis, and ElasticSearch) for LLM applications
  
  

About Team Modulai
  
At Modulai we focus 100% on solving problems with machine learning (ML). We work in teams on a project basis. We work for clients, as part of the core team in startups where we have long-time engagement as well for large enterprises transforming ways of working.
  
Learning and teamwork are central to how we work. Everyone in the team is or will soon be a full-stack ML engineer capable of scoping and developing end-to-end ML solutions. You should be able to do end-to-end machine learning products by yourself but actually, never do it because we always work in teams. If there is data, we will do ML on it!
  
**Apply here:** https://modulai.teamtailor.com/

title: Produktägare med säkerhetsansvar
description:
Vi får samhället att fungera för människor på väg, på spår, i luften och på sjön. Därför behöver vi den bästa kompetensen. Vårt uppdrag är viktigt och har betydelse i vardagen – både för privatpersoner och företag. Hos oss tar vi ansvar, behandlar alla på ett bra sätt och har respekt för olikheter. Som medarbetare bidrar du till en hållbar framtid.

**Om jobbet**
-------------


Är du en person som kan skapa engagemang och trivs att arbeta tillsammans med andra? Nu söker vi en Produktägare till sektionen Korttillverkning.


Som Produktägare kommer du att leda produktområdet genom att sätta långsiktig riktning, säkerställa verksamhetsnytta och styra prioriteringar, planering och leveranser. Rollen verkar som länk mellan verksamhet, ledning och utvecklingsteam och säkerställer att produkten utvecklas och förvaltas i linje med fastställda mål, ekonomiska ramar och gällande regelverk. Anställningen innebär tätt samarbete med andra kompetenser inom både verksamhet och it i en agil miljö.


I rollen kommer du att prioritera och planera produktområdets färdplan och backlogg och säkerställa att det finns relevanta mål som stämmer överens med programmets, och verksamhetens behov. Du agerar bollplank i det dagliga arbetet och stöttar produktområdet med resurshantering, samtidigt som säkerställer att framtagna planer genomförs i rätt tid och med önskat resultat.


Du kommer tillhöra sektionen Korttillverkning som är en del av avdelning Fordonsinformation. Teamet du kommer arbeta närmst består av nio personer med olika funktioner och kompetenser, däribland verksamhetsspecialister, systemutvecklare, scrum master och arkitekt som du kommer ta fram planer och besluta om lösningar tillsammans med.

**Hos oss är du viktig**
------------------------


Gillar du att jobba tillsammans med andra och vill du utvecklas i din yrkesroll? Hos oss kan du förvänta dig karriärsutveckling, ett förtroendefullt chefs- och medarbetarskap och ett hållbart arbetsliv. Vi är en trygg arbetsgivare som månar om din hälsa med tid för friskvård på arbetstid, flexibla arbetstider, väl tilltaget antal semesterdagar och lediga klämdagar.


Läs mer om hur det är att jobba på Transportstyrelsen

**Du kommer även att**
----------------------

* aktivt delta i informationssäkerhetsarbetet, riskanalyser, klassningar för området Kort och certifikat
* övervaka säkerhetsåtgärder vid incidenter etc.ge råd och stöd till avdelningens chefer och medarbetare i säkerhetsarbetet
* ha ansvar för informationssäkerhetsfrågor - fysisk och logisk behörighet
* vara arbetsplatsamordnare (säkerhet) tillsammans med sektionschef
* ha informationssäkerhetsansvar för färdskrivare
* förvalta avtal.

**Du måste ha**
---------------

* akademisk examen inom relevant område, eller motsvarande erfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig
* aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av att leda i utvecklings- och förvaltningsarbete med fokus på it
* erfarenhet av att som verksamhetsrepresentant arbeta i nära samarbete med it
* god erfarenhet av agila metoder och arbetssätt
* mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.

**Det är meriterande om du också har**
--------------------------------------

* erfarenheten av uppdrag eller arbete inom offentlig sektor
* vana att samarbeta med externa leverantörer, gärna inom ramen för offentlig upphandling enligt LOU
* erfarenhet av uppföljning av mål, effekter och resultat
* erfarenhet av arbete med informationssäkerhetsfrågor inom t.ex. fysisk och logisk behörighet eller riskanalyser
* kunskap om eller erfarenhet av förändringsledning i samband med it-utveckling
* arbetat i verktyg för agil planering och uppföljning (t ex. Azure DevOps eller liknande).

**Vi vill att du**
------------------

* är strukturerad, vilket innebär att du planerar, organiserar och prioriterar ditt arbete på ett effektivt sätt
* har ett gott ledarskap där du leder, motiverar och skapar engagemang och delaktighet för att effektivt nå gemensamma mål
* är självgående och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter
* har en god och tydlig kommunikationsförmåga
* arbetar bra tillsammans med andra människor.


Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

**Mer information**
-------------------


Anställningen är tillsvidare med placering i Örebro. Tillsättning enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar normalt provanställning. Möjlighet till distansarbete finns utifrån verksamhetens behov, upp till 3 dagar. En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.


Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta sektionschef Josef Hojeij , 010- 495 6358 josef.hojeij@transportstyrelsen.se. ST, Joakim Wenck och Saco-S, Eva Isaksen nås via vår växel på 0771-503 503.


Vi vill inte att annonsörer och bemanningsföretag kontaktar oss.

**Ansök**
---------


Ansök via vår webbplats och bifoga ett komplett CV samt ett personligt brev märkt med referensnummer TSG 2026-5908. Vi behöver din ansökan senast den 11 september 2026. Har du skyddade personuppgifter, ska du skicka in din ansökan per post, kontakta rekryterande chef för information om hur du går tillväga. I dina ansökningshandlingar behöver du beskriva på vilket sätt du uppfyller efterfrågade kvalifikationer och meriter kopplat till aktuell rekrytering. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid utbildnings-/examensbevis samt tjänstgöringsintyg som styrker de kunskaper och erfarenheter som är relevanta för tjänsten uppvisas.


Välkommen att bli vår nya kollega!

**Kort om Transportstyrelsen**  

  

Transportstyrelsen arbetar för att uppnå god tillgänglighet, hög kvalitet, säkra och miljöanpassade transporter inom järnväg, luftfart, sjöfart och väg. Vi tar fram regler, ger tillstånd och följer upp hur de efterlevs. Med hjälp av våra register arbetar vi bland annat med avgifter, tillstånd och ägarbyten.  

  

Läs mer om Transportstyrelsen

title: AI Engineer till vårt Data-team - Ving
description:
**Vill du utveckla AI-lösningar som skapar verklig nytta – tillsammans med människor från olika delar av verksamheten? Vi söker en utåtriktad och samarbetsorienterad AI Engineer till vårt Data-team.**

### **Om tjänsten**


Som AI Engineer arbetar du med att utveckla, implementera och förbättra AI- och maskininlärningslösningar. Du blir en viktig länk mellan teknik och verksamhet och samarbetar med data engineers, nyckelpersoner i verksamheten, produktteam och plattformsteam.


I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

* Utveckla och produktionssätta AI- och ML-lösningar
* Bygga applikationer på språkmodeller
* Utveckla prognos- och beslutsstödsmodeller
* Sätta upp evaluering och kvalitetsmätning så vi vet om en modell faktiskt fungerar, och märker när den slutar göra det
* Möjliggöra integrationer/API:er som gör modellernas output användbar i våra system
* Förklara tekniska möjligheter, alternativ och begränsningar på ett lättbegripligt sätt
* Realisera idéer från experiment och prototyp till stabil lösning
* Dela kunskap och bidra till våra teams tekniska utveckling inom AI & ML

### **Vår tekniska miljö**


Vi är 13 utvecklingsteam på IT-avdelningen i Stockholm som tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt. Teamen inom Data & Analytics som tillsammans bygger NLTG:s data-, analys- och AI-plattform på Microsoft Fabric.


Med Fabric Data Factory, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse och Fabric Data Science som grund utvecklar vi skalbara lösningar för data engineering, maskininlärning, avancerad analys och AI.


Vi arbetar med moderna tekniker som Python, MLflow, dbt, SQL, Power BI, Azure DevOps och Git. I linje med vår cloud-first-strategi utforskar vi även nästa generations AI-lösningar med Microsoft Foundry, där innovation, kvalitet och affärsvärde står i centrum.


I linje med vår cloud-first-strategi satsar vi på skalbara och framtidssäkra lösningar där innovation, prestanda och kvalitet alltid står i fokus.


Läs mer om **vår IT-avdelning här** ‍

### **Vem söker vi?**


Vi tror att du är nyfiken, initiativrik och tycker om att lösa problem tillsammans med andra. Du är kommunikativ och utåtriktad, trivs med många kontaktytor och har lätt för att skapa förtroende. För dig är samarbete en självklar del av att bygga bra tekniska lösningar.


Vi ser gärna att du har:

* Erfarenhet av AI och maskininlärning
* Goda kunskaper i Python, SQL och relevanta AI-/ML-ramverk
* Erfarenhet av molntjänster (helst Azure),CI/CD & IAC
* Förståelse för data på djupet – modellering, kvalitet & pipelines
* Förmåga att omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
* God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska


Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Foundry eller Azure ML.

### **Vi erbjuder**


Vi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande miljö. Du får en omväxlande vardag tillsammans med härliga kollegor - vi arbetar i nära samarbete med andra team och verksamheten för att ge våra gäster de bästa veckorna på året. Vi har ett högt medarbetarengagemang och en härlig kultur. Vi älskar vårt jobb och välkomnar dig ombord på vår resa i Nordic Leisure Travel Group!


Läs mer om **vad vi erbjuder här**

### **Övrigt**


Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst och placerad på Vings fina huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Det är möjligt med distansarbete upp till 2 dagar per vecka när det passar för teamet/arbetsuppgiften.

**Kontakt:** hakan.sandstrom@nltg.com 0709513226

*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!*

***I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av tester från Alva Labs – ett logiskt problemlösningstest och ett personlighetstest. Testerna utgår från vedertagen forskning och ger oss möjlighet att på ett mer objektivt sätt bedöma dina styrkor och eventuella utmaningar i relation till aktuell tjänst. Du får mer information när du skickat in din ansökan, men om du är nyfiken redan nu kan du läsa mer hos*** ***Alva Labs******.***

***Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetenhet. Innan ett beslut om anställning fattas kommer en bakgrundskontroll att genomföras.***

title: DevOps ingenjör
description:
**Redpill Linpro är ledande open source leverantör och brinner för öppna lösningar, öppna affärsmodeller och ett öppet samhälle - helt enkelt för vi tror att öppenheten skapar ett säkert och hållbart samhälle.**

**Vårt DevOps-team i Stockholm består av runt 20 erfarna specialister. Vi arbetar med bland annat Kubernetes, OpenShift, Red Hat och andra open source-teknologier i konsultprojekt som gör faktisk nytta för samhället.**

**Nu vill vi bli fler och söker dig som är erfaren inom DevOps eller plattform och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med andra som tar tekniken på allvar.**

**Arbetsbeskrivning**
---------------------


Vi söker erfarna DevOps-utvecklare som vill stötta upp våra team och arbeta i en av Nordens tyngsta Linux-miljöer. Tillsammans med riktig vassa kollegor kommer du ta del av spännande kundprojekt och utveckla framtidens lösningar. För dig som har erfarenhet av, eller ett intresse för att utvecklas in i en ledande roll och driva team framåt så erbjuds även denna möjlighet

### **Du kommer exempelvis arbeta med:**

* Systemdrift, arkitektur och code review
* Automatisera arbetsflöden med CI/CD i Git och Jenkins
* Containerteknologer såsom Docker, Kubernetes och OpenShift
* Molnbaserade lösningar såsom AWS, Azure eller OpenStack
* Scriptspråk så som shell script, Ruby och Python
* PostgreSQL/MySQL, Nginx, Varnish och Apache
* Konfigurering i Puppet och Ansible

**Vem är du?**
--------------


För att trivas som konsult hos oss har du ett stort teknikintresse och en vilja att utvecklas inom nya områden och i ny teknik. Du drivs av problemlösning och förstår att det är samarbete som för oss framåt.

### **Utöver ovanstående kompetenser ser vi att du har:**

* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom relaterat område

title: CloudOps Engineer
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a CloudOps Engineer for the next phase of growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a CloudOps Engineer within our Engineering Enabler Domain, you will bridge the gap between robust infrastructure and developer velocity. You will have end-to-end ownership of our AWS platform, balancing hands-on technical execution with cross-functional mentorship to help product teams become self-sufficient. This mission-oriented role splits focus between driving strategic platform improvements and enabling engineering teams to scale efficiently.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own the central AWS platform architecture, ensuring infrastructure and deployment tools align with shared best practices.
* Mentor product engineers through collaborative troubleshooting, helping them understand root causes to drive long-term operational self-sufficiency.
* Drive the implementation of prioritized platform upgrades, maintaining high system availability and minimal infrastructure incidents.
* Manage and resolve incidents within the core platform while serving as a senior technical resource for complex system troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with stakeholders during early-stage discovery and planning to define technical scope, manage expectations, and map delivery timelines.


 What we’re looking for
   

  

 We are looking for an engineer with a systems-thinking mindset who can blend tactical execution with long-term platform strategy. You thrive on driving alignment across engineering teams, possess strong self-leadership, and are motivated to build scalable delivery and observability frameworks.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Several years of experience working with cloud infrastructure.
* Strong technical expertise within the AWS ecosystem and related operations tooling.
* Proven background in system observability, infrastructure-as-code, and incident mitigation.
* Experience working in high-growth Fintech, banking, or similar regulated financial environments is a plus.


 Why Qred?
   

  

 This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
   

  

 One Last Thing
   

  

 This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
   

  

*Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexua* 
*l orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.*
 Qred is an international FinTech scale-up that specializes in digital financing solutions for small businesses, with operations in the Nordics, Benelux, Germany and Brazil. We are passionate about helping small businesses thrive and grow, by providing them with business loans and credit cards. Right now we’re in an exciting phase of our journey that focuses on growth through smart product development and technology fueled by international expansion.

title: Data Engineer
description:
At Strawberry, we don’t just run hotels, we’re building a universe of experiences. We are rewriting the hospitality playbook through tech and innovation, and data is the engine powering it all.
   

  

 We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our central Tech BI team. You’ll sit right at the heart of our tech transformation, building scalable datasets and data models that power business decisions, digital products and AI solutions.
   

  

 If you’re excited about the modern data stack, obsessed with clean architecture, and eager to leverage AI to push the boundaries of traditional BI, Welcome Home.
   

  

 Our Tech Stack
   

  

* Data Warehouse: Snowflake
* Transformation & Governance: dbt
* Orchestration: Apache Airflow
* Cloud & DevOps: Cloud Platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP), Git, CI/CD
* Languages: SQL, Python


 You won't just be maintaining pipelines, As part of our central Tech BI team, you’ll build and evolve the shared data platform while enabling Data Product Teams across the business to deliver trusted, high-quality data products.
   

  

 Working with our modern data stack, you’ll transform raw, complex data into scalable data models that power business decisions, digital products and AI solutions.
   

  

 You’ll work at the intersection of our central data platform and our Data Product Teams, enabling reliable data foundations while supporting business-specific data products. As we continue investing in AI, you’ll help build trusted data foundations that enable analytics, automation and future AI solutions.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Core Platform Ownership: Build, maintain, and optimize the core datasets, transformations and pipelines that power our enterprise data platform.
* Partner with Data Product Teams: Work closely with cross-functional Data Product teams aligned directly with the business to deliver tailored datasets, analytics solutions, and actionable insights.
* Own the Data Lifecycle: Design and implement scalable data models in Snowflake, leveraging dbt for transformations, testing, documentation and version controlling.
* Build Robust ELT Workflows: Develop, orchestrate, and optimize reliable data pipelines using Airflow to seamlessly integrate diverse source systems.
* Drive AI & Innovation: Partner with engineering and product teams to build trusted data foundations that enable advanced analytics, AI solutions and new data products.
* Code & Automate: Use Python to build data pipelines, automate workflows and integrate source systems.
* Ensure Quality & Documentation: Ensure data assets are monitored, documented and easy for others to understand and reuse.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Proven Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, BI, or Data Architecture.
* Core Tech Expertise: Strong proficiency in SQL, deep experience with Snowflake, and hands-on expertise with dbt and Airflow.
* Programming & Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for data manipulation, workflow automation, and integrations.
* Cloud & Platform Mindset: Good understanding of cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and modern CI/CD/Git practices.
* Business & Product Alignment: Experience or interest in collaborating directly with product teams and business stakeholders to solve real-world problems.
* Collaboration & Communication: Humble, curious, and collaborative. You communicate clearly in English, ask great questions, and leave your ego at the door.
* Education: BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).


 What’s In It For You?
   

  

* Real Impact: High visibility, strong autonomy, and a flat culture where your ideas actually get built.
* Growth & Learning: Space and resources to level up your skills in modern data stack practices and AI.
* Unbeatable Perks: Deep discounts on hotel stays, dining, and experiences for you, your friends, and your family across the Strawberry universe.
* Vibrant Culture: A fun, passionate team with regular social events, team activities, and a passion for celebrating wins.
* Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy a balanced work model with 3 days of high-energy collaboration at our sleek Stockholm HQ and 2 days working from home.


 (Please note: This role is based in our Stockholm office. Candidates must be local or ready to relocate to Stockholm, as we do not offer fully remote setups.)
   

  

 Ready to build something iconic?
   

  

 Don't just wait, we review applications continuously and are eager to meet you! Apply today.

title: Go To Market Engineer
description:
Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite built for retail. More than 500 brands across 100 markets use Voyado to create better customer experiences through AI-driven CRM, loyalty, and product discovery.
   

  

**We’re now looking for a Go To Market Engineer to join our Revenue Operations team.**
 This role is for someone who gets genuinely excited about AI, workflows, systems, and operational efficiency, and who enjoys figuring out how technology can help commercial teams work smarter.
   

  

 You’ll help Voyado move from pockets of impressive AI usage to something scalable, structured, and embedded across the organisation.
   

  

 Working closely with RevOps, Sales, SDR, Marketing, and Customer teams, you’ll identify opportunities, build solutions, and help scale AI across the revenue organisation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a GTM Engineer, you’ll help identify, prioritise, build, and operationalise AI-driven workflows and automations across the full revenue lifecycle.
   

  

 A key part of the role is understanding where commercial teams lose time, where workflows break down, and where AI can create meaningful operational impact.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Revenue Leadership, RevOps, Sales, Marketing, and Customer teams to improve efficiency, reduce administrative work, and create scalable ways of working across the organisation.
   

  

 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Identify opportunities for AI and automation across the revenue organisation
* Run workshops and collaborate with commercial stakeholders
* Build AI agents, workflows, and automations connected to platforms such as Salesforce, Gong, and HubSpot
* Create practical AI use cases that reduce admin work and increase customer-facing time
* Support implementation, adoption, and scalability across teams


 Who you are
   

  

 You’re curious, pragmatic, and genuinely interested in how AI can improve the way people work.
   

  

 We believe you:
   

  

* Have experience within GTM, RevOps, SaaS, or commercial operations
* Have worked with AI tools and automation in practical business contexts
* Understand systems such as Salesforce, Gong, HubSpot, or similar platforms
* Enjoy solving operational problems and improving workflows
* Are collaborative, proactive, and curious about AI


 You do not need to be a full-stack engineer; what matters most is your mindset, execution capability, and willingness to learn.
   

  

 What's in it for you?
   

  

 You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.
   

  

 At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.
   

  

 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* Wellness allowance
* Personal development opportunities
* Summits and team activities
* Four days from the office and one day from home


 More on Voyado
   

  

 Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.
   

  

 More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel - online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
   

  

 We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact?
   

  

 Fantastic! 🎉
   

  

 Applying is easy — submit your LinkedIn profile or upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
   

  

 Making it personal with AI
   

  

 We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.
   

  

 In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.
   

  

 With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

title: Senior Engineer (Founding)
description:
We're building an AI travel agent for groups: your coolest, most helpful friend, inside an app. Hal, our agent, turns a vague idea into a real trip. Not a chatbot that hands you suggestions, but an agent that orchestrates tools across flight, stay, rail and ticket inventory, for a whole group at once, in a shared itinerary everyone is editing in real time.
   

  

 You would be our founding senior engineer, and the senior-most engineer in the company. Hold the technical bar at 100x scale, own the architectural calls that decide whether Halcy works at our next order of magnitude, and stay deep in the code, shipping every week alongside the three founders.
   

  

 What you will mostly do
   

  

 Hold the product vision in your head and translate it into the technical bets that make it real. Own the architectural calls on concurrency, AI cost, collaborative state and content delivery on mobile. Stand up the operational floor: observability, error tracking, end-to-end coverage on critical journeys, alerting. Build the speed infrastructure that lets the team ship faster as it grows. Set the bar for our next ten engineering hires.
   

  

 Must have
   

  

 5+ years building production systems, including at least one tour as the senior-most engineer in a small team. Deep TypeScript across the stack (React + Node or Deno) and the judgment to make architectural calls without a senior peer to bounce them off. A track record of levelling up the engineers around you. Scar tissue from at least one of: real-time multiplayer at scale, payments and bookings, or RLS-heavy Postgres at hundreds of tables.
   

  

 Bonus
   

  

 Mobile delivery, whether Capacitor, React Native or native. We ship to App Store and Play Store. Pragmatic on observability and security. Shipped AI-heavy products to real users, fluent in tool-use orchestration, multi-model gateways, prompt evaluation and the cost mechanics of running LLMs in production. We run Anthropic and Gemini side by side, and you should have opinions on this.
   

  

 Our stack
   

  

 React, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase and Postgres, React Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind, Mapbox, Capacitor, Trigger.dev, PostHog, Sentry.
   

  

 The offer
   

  

 1,100,000 to 2,000,000 SEK, calibrated to experience. Meaningful equity, four-year vest with a one-year cliff. Hybrid in Stockholm. Real ownership over a domain from day one.
   

  

 Full role description: https://halcy.site/careers/roles/senior-engineer

title: Sektionschef Platform software
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*
 Din roll
   

  

 Som mjukvaruchef leder och utvecklar du ett team som arbetar med avancerade plattformsfunktioner i C++ för telekrigssystem som används i moderna stridsflygplan.
   

  

 Du blir en viktig del av en verksamhet där mjukvara, teknik och ledarskap möts. Sektionen består idag av åtta medarbetare och står inför en spännande tillväxtresa. Du får därför en central roll i att utveckla både teamet, arbetssätten och vår tekniska förmåga när organisationen växer.
   

  

 I rollen leder du det dagliga arbetet och skapar förutsättningar för teamet att lyckas. Du arbetar nära medarbetarna, andra utvecklingsteam och verksamhetens olika funktioner för att prioritera, lösa problem och driva verksamheten framåt.
   

  

 Rollen ger dig möjlighet att kombinera ledarskap med en tekniskt avancerad miljö där det du och teamet utvecklar blir en del av produkter med höga krav på kvalitet, prestanda och robusthet.
   

  

 Din profil
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har en bakgrund inom mjukvara och ledarskap. Du har förståelse för mjukvaruutveckling och trivs i en teknisk miljö där problemlösning, samarbete och kvalitet står i centrum.
   

  

 Du behöver inte ha varit chef tidigare. Vi ser lika gärna att du har utvecklat ditt ledarskap i en annan roll, exempelvis som Scrum Master, Product Owner, teknisk ledare eller motsvarande. Det viktiga är att du har ett genuint intresse för människor, teknik och att få team att fungera och utvecklas tillsammans.
   

  

 Vi tror att du:
   

  

* Har erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, gärna inom C++.
* Har erfarenhet av ledarskap, exempelvis som chef, Scrum Master, Product Owner, teknisk ledare eller i någon annan roll där du har fått människor och team att utvecklas.
* Har ett genuint intresse för att leda och utveckla människor.
* Är kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa förtroende och bygga goda relationer.
* Trivs med att arbeta i en komplex teknisk miljö tillsammans med andra kompetenser.
* Är strukturerad och har förmåga att skapa riktning och framdrift även när förutsättningarna förändras.
* Är nyfiken och vill fortsätta utvecklas, både som ledare och inom teknik.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, utveckling av realtidssystem, inbyggda system eller andra säkerhets- och prestandakritiska mjukvarusystem.
   

  

 Framför allt söker vi dig som vill vara med och bygga ett starkt team. Du behöver inte ha alla svar från början – det viktigaste är att du har en teknisk grund, ett starkt ledarskap och viljan att utvecklas tillsammans med oss.
   

  

 Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
   

  

 Vad du blir en del av
   

  

 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här
   

  

 Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

title: Experienced healthcare IT experts, doers and leaders
description:
Experienced healthcare IT experts, doers and leaders strengthening Karolinska’s “CDR catalyst” integration and AI context initiative.
   

  

*We are looking for international top competence that can strengthen Karolinska’s “CDR catalyst” integration and AI context initiative. These positions are in the form of project recruitments that according to current Swedish regulations can last maximum 4 years. (If we announce permanent positions during that time, you are of course welcome to apply to those and switch form of employment.)*
* All of the positions (except the project leader one) can be performed mostly remote from anywhere in the world if you wish – provided you remotely can attend some meetings per week during Swedish business hours and also can travel to Stockholm some times per year and spend some consecutive days here.
* If you find these tasks exciting, but you are bound by other existing obligations we may for some positions also consider part time employments, and one or several shorter limited time contract periods that fit you and us. Such periods can start later during the initiative, but you are wise to apply already now, since application to this ad has an end date.


 Before applying to any of the positions you need to read the entire “CDR Catalyst” initiative available from: https://discourse.openehr.org/t/join-or-comment-cdr-catalyst-initiative-from-karolinska/16859 (öppnas i nytt fönster) since some of the filtering questions are based on your thoughts from reading it. Other questions are based on mandatory requirements.
   

  

 You are also expected to upload a CV (but no personal letter). We want a balanced expert team so interviews, relevant knowledge/expertise/experience and CVs carry a lot of weight in the selection process.
   

  

 We do have other ways to recruit and procure general IT-competence, including general AI competence, for example Region Stockholm IT Consultancy agreement (a DPS – dynamic purchasing system open to suitable firms to apply to at any time). So if you do not fit the specific requirements below, then please focus on getting your firm/employer to join that DPS rather than spending your and our time on an application here.
   

  

 Applicants should be aware of that, like at most university hospitals, we start with a backlog of unmet needs. The team will assist in continuously detecting and reducing bottlenecks (technical, organizational/way of work etc.) and in finding all sorts of ways to catalyze and safely speed up development both within the initiative and in related teams/projects. This can be done e.g. via better ways-of-work and via automation (including with AI when data can be well understood by AI).
   

  

 Experienced health IT project leader (1-2 positions)
   

  

****Purpose And Responsibilities:****
* Coordinate all stages of CDR Catalyst initiative by aligning technical delivery, resource planning, and stakeholder engagement.
* Build a project culture that combines rigorous semantic and architectural thinking with pragmatic, iterative progress and deliveries.
* The culture you build needs to be open-minded and safely harbor mixed thoughts, opinions and predictions about the rapidly shifting IT and medical/scientific landscape. You need to direct the initiative in a way that ensures that clinical teams and researchers can actually use the resulting systems, tools and data within reasonable time from when new needs surface.
* Coordinate the collaboration in the (likely international) core CDR Catalyst doer/builder/architect/informatics team and facilitate collaboration with other teams.
* Coordinate (and help recruit and adjust) the CDR Catalyst international strategic advisory board over different phases of the initiative.
* At times when the CDR catalyst initiative does not need your full attention and all working hours you will help leading or assisting other initiatives at the hospital and in the region


****Requirements****
* You are experienced in talking directly to clinical stakeholders, researchers, developers, architects and hospital/regional management. A lot of this communication will be in Swedish during meetings etc. (Even though most will know English very well.)
* You are experienced in leading teams of experts, getting them to jointly deliver value needed by stakeholders (including end users).
* You are usually available for weekly meetings in Stockholm (sometimes more often)
* You have a working proficiency in Swedish and English, so that you can participate in meetings and dialogues in Swedish and Enlgish.
* At least three years of verifiable experience leading health IT projects, preferably also complex ones.


**Meritorious**
* Verifiable long experience, educations and courses in health IT technologies/standards and related leadership


 Experienced health IT doers, builders, architects, informatics- and integration-specialists (2-5 positions)
   

  

 We Believe Some Of The Best Candidates For These Positions May Have Experience And Interest Covering Several Of The Roles Below. Thus The Questions For These Positions In The Ad Are Combined So You Can Describe Your Skills And Interests Instead Of Just Picking One Of Them:
   

  

* Senior clinical modeling experts and integration experts experienced in combinations of openEHR, FHIR, OMOP, SNOMED CT, ontologies, terminology binding etc. (We suspect most such experts are only available part time)
* Technological realization – smart doers/builders/toolmakers and AI expertise experienced in electronic health data, and/or “third AI-wave” combinations like neuro-symbolic solutions. With understanding for and interest in the goals expressed in the CDR Catalyst draft document.
* Semantic framework (knowledge graph etc.) strategist with deep openEHR and ontology-knowledge [One position for this role is in the process of being filled already when this ad is published, but we don’t mind more such experts if available full- or part-time]


****Requirements****
* Education and experience fitting the role(s) applied for (see questions)
* Remote or on site – ability to travel to Stockholm some times per year and spending some consecutive days here. And possibility to join remote meetings during some part of Swedish business hours 1-2 times a week. We’ll try adjust to time zones of team members if possible.


**Meritous**
* Existing provable deep multi-year engagement in health-IT standardization organizations, research and practical use.
* Experience in disciplined efficient use of AI-agents for creating and maintaining software and other information assets. For implementation we will use a lot of AI and you must be able to set up the work in control loops with verification etc so that delegation is safe and the balance between HTIL and automation is continuously being optimized.
* For Senior clinical modeling experts it is meritous to be very experienced in openEHR, terminology binding using SNOMED CT etc.


****About The Recruitment Process****
 Selection and interviews may be conducted on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 In our recruitment process, we may use Assessio's MAP and Matrigma tests. MAP is a personality test and Matrigma is a non-verbal cognitive ability test, both of which are based on research in occupational psychology. The tests are used to complement your experience and skills, and the purpose is to ensure our selection process is quality-assured and transparent.
   

  

 Regarding your application, you need to attach a CV and instead of a cover letter - we ask you to answer selection questions and briefly explain why you are a good fit for the role. Answering these questions is a prerequisite for your application to be considered complete.
   

  

 For permanent positions, a probationary period may apply.
   

  

**We warmly welcome your application - Together we are Karolinska!**
 Inför tillsättning av befattning som innefattar vård av barn och ungdom, kontrolleras den som erbjuds tjänsten mot misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Här kan du läsa mer om rekryteringsprocessen och om vilka kontroller som utförs på Karolinska.
   

  

 Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset kan du komma att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om vad det innebär här.
   

  

 Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Stockholm kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef om du blir aktuell för anställning.
   

  

 För tillsvidaretjänster kan provanställning komma att tillämpas.
   

  

**Om Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset**
 Vi på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är stolta över att vi är ett av världens främsta universitetssjukhus. Förutom vårt särskilda ansvar för den högspecialiserade vården i Stockholmsregionen är huvuduppdraget att tillsammans med Karolinska Institutet utbilda framtidens vårdanställda och bedriva världsledande forskning samtidigt som vi fortsätter vårt arbete med att utveckla vården för patientens bästa. Vi arbetar inom en rad olika områden och professioner.
   

  

 Du kan läsa mer om vårt uppdrag inom vård, forskning och utbildning här.
   

  

 Vår vision - Vi ska bota och lindra imorgon det ingen kan bota och lindra idag.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss på karolinska.se och följ oss på sociala medier!
   

  

**Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm**
 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  

 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  

 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  

 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

title: Technical Project Manager (AI Focus)
description:
**AddanEx JOB POSTING:**




**Title:** 
 Technical Project Manager (AI)
 



**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden
 



**Onsite / Remote:** 
 Onsite 2-3 days per week
 



**Type:** 
 Contract
 



**Start Date** 
 : ASAP / September – October
 



**Duration:** 
 6 Months + Extensions
 



**Utilisation:** 
 40 Hours per week
 



**Languages:** 
 Swedish & English
 




  





**Job Summary / Key Skills**



* Delivered technical projects across organisational boundaries in a large enterprise, things that
 **finished**
* Has driven deliveries through a formal IT service-introduction or ITSM process (service portfolios, solution documents, governance-forum approvals, CMDB, service-desk handover).
* Security or compliance change delivery through an InfoSec/risk function
* Taken a SaaS product from evaluation to production in an enterprise: assessment, contract, identity integration, rollout
* Written English of publishable quality, the main output is documents other people act on
* **A hands-on, daily AI user:** 
 already produces real working documents with LLM assistants and can show it; knows how to prompt, verify and edit AI output rather than paste it. The role's document volume assumes AI-assisted production from day one
* **Technically conversant to the depth of a real discussion:** 
 can talk through RBAC models, API scopes, SSO flows and data classification without needing terms explained. Time as product or project manager for a backend or platform team is the right shape of background.
* Comfortable operating without authority
* **Deliberately not required:** 
 PM certifications (PMP/PRINCE2/SAFe), line-management experience, deep engineering.



  





**Task:**




 The client is setting up a central AI team to make AI easy to consume, safe by default and financially accountable across a decentralised group of 42,000 people. The AI platform and its operations are run by a small engineering team; policy is set by Legal and the CISO's security initiative. This engagement is the first person into the new team.
 



  





**The Job:**




 Drive the non-engineering work that currently blocks the programme, across organisational boundaries where the team has no authority to compel anyone:
 



  




* **Security and compliance changes:** 
 run them as tracked deliveries to closure: scope, owners, sign-off. Coordinate InfoSec, Legal and division owners; the role makes reviews finish, it does not perform them
* **AI tool intake and onboarding:** 
 build and run the end-to-end path for new AI services, in both shapes: external tools brought in (the first external tool is in intake now: assessment, data-classification review, commercial with Procurement, identity setup, pilot, rollout, decision record) and internally built products launched as Service Offerings (the same path while the product is being productised: solution documentation, support model, pricing). These are first-of-their-kind runs; the process is being written by running it
* **Integration assessments and scope-change re-assessments:** 
 existing integrations whose permissions widen or grow new components. The group-wide collaboration platform is the expensive case: changes to an existing integration there trigger a security revision of the Technical Solution Document; changes elsewhere are light. Two live examples, both on the expensive path: a connector originally assessed with read scopes now has write, and an add-in is waiting on enablement. The role drives each end to end: TSD security revision, approvals, configuration, rollout
* **The approval legwork:** 
 the approvals are internal. Client runs a formal Group IT service-introduction process (impact analysis, anchoring decks in governance forums, a Technical Solution Document, an ordered security review, Service Portal offerings, CMDB, business pilot, service-desk handover). The role drives AI services through that process: the meetings, the decks, prompt answers to security's questions, one-to-one alignment with the people who each hold a piece of the yes. This is the majority of the job, and the candidate should see it as the job, not as overhead around it
* **Documentation:** 
 the intake process, runbooks, decision records, the AI use-case register, and the policy-to-control mapping (policy itself is set elsewhere). The volume is high and most of it is produced with the AI assistants the platform itself provides: drafting with AI and editing to publishable quality is the working method, not an aspiration
* **Programme cadence:** 
 one status view: what is in flight, what is blocked, who owes what by when
* **Boundary agreements:** 
 carry five written scope agreements (Product Compliance, DevX, InfoSec, data organisation, the CISO's AI-policy initiative) to signature



  





*If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply now with your updated CV in MS Word format to Applications@AddanEx.com*

title: Machine Learning Engineer - Data, ML & Applied AI
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.
   

  

 We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a
 **Machine Learning Engineer** 
 in our
 **Stockholm** 
 office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who wants to combine strong data and machine learning fundamentals with the opportunities created by modern AI.
   

  

 At Viaplay, you'll help build the models and data products that shape how millions of people discover and experience entertainment. You'll work across the ML lifecycle from understanding data and selecting the right algorithms to building pipelines, deploying models, and monitoring them in production.
   

  

 You'll also help us develop more effective ways of working with AI. This includes using AI-assisted, spec-driven workflows and building reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge-based solutions. The goal is practical impact: delivering faster, reducing technical debt, improving access to knowledge, and creating reliable systems that are easier to develop and maintain.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who understands that AI can significantly improve how we work but that great solutions still depend on high-quality data, sound ML principles, critical thinking, and thoughtful engineering.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models for recommendations, predictions, classification, and personalization
* Build and maintain scalable data and ML pipelines in a modern cloud environment
* Use AI-assisted, spec-driven workflows to turn clear requirements into tested, production-ready solutions
* Build reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge-based tools that support data, ML, and engineering teams
* Apply AI to improve existing systems, automate repetitive work, and reduce technical debt
* Collaborate with product, engineering, data science, content, commercial, and marketing teams
* Monitor models and pipelines to ensure they remain reliable, understandable, and effective.


**What We’re Looking For**
 We're seeking someone who combines technical depth with strategic thinking and a curious, problem-solving mindset.
   

  

 We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following:
   

  

* 3+ years of experience applying machine learning or data science in production
* A solid understanding of data, statistics, and core ML algorithms - including how to select and evaluate the right approach
* Experience taking ML projects from problem definition and experimentation through deployment and monitoring
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using Spark or similar data-processing technologies
* Experience building data pipelines and using orchestration tools such as Airflow
* Practical experience with or strong curiosity about generative AI, AI agents, and AI-assisted engineering
* The ability to review and validate AI-generated output rather than treating it as automatically correct
* Clear communication skills and a collaborative, curious approach to problem-solving


**It’s a bonus if you have:** 
  

  

* Experience with recommender systems, search, ranking, or personalization.
* Experience building AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, or internal knowledge tools
* Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, MLOps, CI/CD, and observability
* Experience in streaming, media, e-commerce, or another digital product environment


**You don't need to meet every requirement to apply. We value different perspectives, a willingness to learn, and people who are excited to explore how strong ML foundations and modern AI can work together to create meaningful products.**
 What we offer you
   

  

* We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
* A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
* An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
* Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.


**Hit play today**
 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Events Manager | EMEA | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.



We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.



You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

### **The Opportunity:**



As our EMEA Events Manager, you'll independently own and deliver Grafana's regional events across EMEA and, over time, APJ, from our ObservabilityCON on the Road conferences to our third-party sponsorship portfolio. This is a hands-on role for an experienced event manager who has run their own conferences end-to-end: sourced and contracted the venue, managed the budget, managed the vendors, and been on-site when something goes wrong. You'll work across marketing, sales, product, and regional teams, and you'll own the outcome of your events, not just their execution. We move fast, we expect high standards, and we're building an AI-first marketing team, so curiosity about new tools and rigor about their output both matter here.


### **What You’ll Be Doing:**


* Independently manage and execute a portfolio of in-person events, including owned regional user conferences and third-party sponsorships, across EMEA and eventually APJ
* Lead end-to-end event logistics, including venue sourcing, negotiating, and contracting, vendor coordination, booth design and setup, and on-site execution.
* Own event project management, maintaining detailed timelines, budgets, contracts, and vendor communications while ensuring alignment and visibility across stakeholders.
* Define and track event success metrics; deliver post-event analysis and translate insights into actionable improvements that increase performance and ROI.
* Create, review, and approve event assets such as signage, collateral, presentations, and registration experiences to ensure brand consistency and high-quality execution.
* Leverage and build AI and automation tools to improve planning efficiency, execution accuracy, and reporting processes.
* Identify risks early and resolve issues proactively, leading real-time problem-solving and on-site decision-making.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, sales, product, and regional teams to align event strategy with broader business objectives.
* Provide guidance to junior team members, contractors, and agency partners while remaining hands-on in execution.

### **What Makes You a Great Fit:**


* Located in the UK, Netherlands, Sweden, or Germany
* 4+ years of direct event management experience, including hosted conferences you personally owned end to end and third-party conference sponsorships you ran independently.
* Demonstrated ownership of the full event lifecycle: venue sourcing, negotiating, and contracting, budget ownership and reconciliation, vendor management, registration build, on-site delivery as the lead, and post-event analysis.
* Experience as the primary on-site lead for in-person events, making real-time decisions on vendors, staffing, run of show, and unforeseen problems without escalation.
* Willingness to travel by plane, approximately 40 percent. This includes long-haul travel to APJ and occasional work across APJ/AMER time zones, and flexibility during peak event seasons, when travel may be frequent and involve back-to-back trips over extended periods.
* Curiosity and adaptability in adopting new marketing technologies, including AI-driven tools such as Claude Code
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to collaborate across global, cross-functional teams.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent events with competing deadlines and shifting priorities while maintaining quality.
* Proven track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder events with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to anticipate needs and identify gaps.
* Demonstrated problem-solving and sound decision-making skills in fast-paced, ambiguous situations.
* Proficiency in Zuddl or similar registration platforms and familiarity with Salesforce and Monday.com preferred.

### **What Success Looks Like in This Role:**


* Deep event management craft, including the judgment that comes from having run events that didn't go to plan.
* A positive, solutions-oriented mindset in high-pressure situations.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Intellectual curiosity and a drive for continuous improvement.
* Initiative, ownership, and accountability for outcomes.
* Strong analytical and project management capabilities.
* Ability to assess results and recommend data-driven improvements.
* Comfort working across different business cultures, regions, and time zones.
* Strong stakeholder communication, with the ability to bring cross-functional partners along from early planning through execution.
* Sound budget and commercial judgment, including negotiating with vendors and knowing where to invest versus where to pull back.
* Flexibility and resilience in an evolving environment with competing priorities.
* A service-oriented approach and the ability to build strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Practical experience applying AI tools to enhance research, analysis, and operational efficiency while maintaining rigorous quality control.

### **Compensation & Rewards:**

  


In Sweden the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is SEK 670,000 - SEK 805,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

  

* *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.*


**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**


* **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* **Open Source Roots** – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* **In-Person onboarding** - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* **Balance is Key** - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.*


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*


*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*



#LI-Remote



*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*
