title: Machine Learning Engineer to SaaS-company!
description:
Are you an ML Engineer with hands-on experience taking machine learning models from development all the way into production? Do you also have a strong foundation in data engineering and enjoy working independently in a collaborative team? Then this could be your next opportunity!
  
ABOUT THE POSITION
  
Friday is now looking for an ML Engineer with Data Engineering competence who wants to join a growing data product team. Over the past two years, the team has built a modern data platform with a strong focus on Databricks. The focus is now shifting towards building an intelligence layer that will enable advanced solutions such as forecasting, ranking, and recommendation systems.
  
As an ML Engineer, your main focus will be applied machine learning. You will take ownership of models throughout their entire lifecycle, from development and deployment to monitoring and maintenance in production. At the same time, you will contribute to the underlying data platform when needed, making this a role where both your ML and data engineering skills will come into play.
  
You’ll be part of a smaller, collaborative team consisting of Data Engineers, a Product Manager and an Engineering Manager. The team places great value on inclusiveness, psychological safety and different perspectives. The role offers a high level of ownership, giving you the opportunity to work proactively, contribute your own ideas and have a real impact on how the team's work develops.
  
  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

Design and develop ML models for forecasting, ranking and recommendation systems.
  
Take full ownership of the model lifecycle, from development and deployment to monitoring and maintenance in production.
  
Work closely with product teams to determine how model outputs should be integrated and used within the product.
  
Contribute to the data platform, including data ingestion pipelines, observability and platform maintenance.
  
Troubleshoot issues across both data pipelines and deployed ML models.
  
Develop high-quality, maintainable code in line with established coding practices and conventions.
  
**WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:** Has 1–2 years of hands-on, end-to-end ML experience, including taking models into production.
  
Has 3+ years of experience in data engineering or data-related software engineering in a cloud environment.
  
Has strong hands-on experience with Databricks as well as Python and SQL.
  
Has a solid understanding of data platform fundamentals, including data ingestion, observability and maintenance.
  
Is familiar with modern software development and delivery practices.
  
Has experience working in a cloud environment such as Azure, AWS or GCP.
  
  

**It is not required, but considered a plus if you have:**  

Experience with additional cloud-based data or ML technologies.
  
Experience contributing to the architecture and development of data platforms.
  
  

As a person, we believe you are proactive, self-driven and solution-oriented. You enjoy taking ownership of your work and are comfortable navigating complex technical challenges independently. At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys sharing ideas, collaborating with others and contributing to a positive team environment.
  
ABOUT THE EMPLOYMENT
  
This is a consulting assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The ambition from both the customer and Friday is for you to transition into direct employment with the customer.
  
**Start date:** As soon as possible, but considering the notice period.
  
**Location:** Gothenburg.
  
**Salary:** Fixed monthly.
  
**Employment type:** Full-time / Part-time
  
ABOUT FRIDAY
  
By being a partner to both our candidates and clients, we strive to find the best possible match. We do this by truly getting to know both our clients and candidates. Naturally, we make sure that skills and experience requirements align, but above all, we place great importance on shared values and a company culture that both parties appreciate.
  
Our passion is helping people find the right role, workplace and professional environment within IT and technology. That is why we founded Friday, with the ambition of helping you find a job that gives you that Friday feeling – every day!
  
We primarily focus on people who are at the beginning of their careers or are currently studying IT or engineering at a university or college.
  
We believe that people reach their full potential when they look forward to going to work every morning. “Friday – everyday” – how does that sound?

title: Product Delivery Manager
description:
***Do you want to shape the future with us?***

##### **Role Overview**


The Product Delivery Manager supports Product Management and R&D in turning product strategy into coordinated, measurable execution and will be part of the Product Management & Innovation Team reporting to the Chief Product Officer.


Working closely with Product Managers, R&D, and the CPO, the role ensures that priorities are translated into clear plans, dependencies are actively managed, and agreed outcomes are delivered. The Product Delivery Manager enables these teams to operate effectively by creating transparency, maintaining momentum, and removing operational friction.


The role combines elements of product operations, program management, release management, and commercial product administration. It is particularly suited to someone who is highly structured, collaborative, and comfortable coordinating work across multiple functions.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**OKRs and Team Execution**

* Drive quarterly OKR planning, check-ins, progress tracking, and retrospectives.
* Ensure OKRs are measurable, outcome-oriented, and aligned with company priorities.
* Escalate risks, blockers, resource conflicts, and unclear ownership.

**Prioritization and Delivery**

* Translate priorities into clear plans, actions, owners, dependencies, and deadlines.
* Facilitate prioritization, roadmap, capacity, and delivery reviews.
* Maintain a consolidated view of priorities, progress, risks, and cross-team initiatives.

**Requirements and Releases**

* Support Product Managers with requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate release plans, readiness reviews, documentation, and commercial readiness.
* Align Product, R&D, Sales, Support, Operations, and other stakeholders.

**Licensing and Pricing**

* Maintain licensing, packaging, subscriptions, entitlements, and upgrade information.
* Coordinate licensing changes and pricing-guide updates across relevant teams and systems.
* Support updates to CRM, CPQ, ERP, and pricing tools.

**Product Operations**

* Coordinate product and release documentation.
* Establish an effective meeting and planning cadence for Product and R&D.
* Improve transparency, accountability, tools, templates, and working practices while reducing unnecessary administration.

##### **Experience and Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, program management, product management, controlling, project management, or a related field.
* One to three years of experience in product operations, project coordination, program management, product management, business operations, or technology delivery.
* Strong practical knowledge of Scrum, OKRs, and agile product-development principles.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several parallel initiatives, dependencies, and stakeholders.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English; Swedish is an advantage.
* Ability to prepare structured decision material, plans, meeting documentation, and status reporting.
* Confidence in following up on commitments, identifying blockers, and escalating risks constructively.
* Strong proficiency with collaboration, documentation, spreadsheet, presentation, and planning tools.

**Preferred**

* Experience as a Scrum Master, Product Owner, or in a similar agile delivery role.
* Experience working with R&D or engineering teams.
* Familiarity with product roadmaps, backlogs, release planning, requirements, and user stories.
* Familiarity with commercial product processes, including pricing, licensing, product launches, and lifecycle management.

**Personal Characteristics**


The successful candidate is:

* Structured and dependable.
* Proactive rather than reactive.
* Comfortable creating clarity in ambiguous situations.
* Persistent in following up without becoming bureaucratic.
* Collaborative and able to influence without formal authority.
* Curious about customers, products, technology, and commercial models.
* Capable of challenging unclear requirements or unrealistic commitments constructively.
* Focused on outcomes rather than task completion alone.
* Comfortable working across organizational boundaries.
* Eager to learn and grow toward a broader product-operations, program-management, or product-management role.

##### **Role Summary**


The Junior Product Delivery Manager is the operational connective tissue between Product Management, R&D, Innovation, and the wider organization.


The role ensures that product teams have clear objectives, transparent priorities, coordinated plans, complete commercial and operational readiness, and disciplined follow-through. By reducing operational friction and improving execution, the role enables Product Managers and engineers to focus more effectively on solving meaningful customer problems and delivering valuable products.

**WELCOME TO APPLY**


The position is permanent, full-time employment located in our headquarters in Solna. We value work-life balance; therefore, you can combine remote work and work from the office.

 **ABOUT NET INSIGHT**

*Net Insight (Nasdaq: NETI B) provides the highest performing, most open video transport and media cloud technology for content providers as the industry standard for flexibility and service across live contribution, distribution and remote production media workflows.*

*For over 25 years, the world’s leading content owners, broadcasters, production companies, service providers and enterprises have trusted Net Insight’s Emmy Award winning Nimbra technology to guarantee media delivery. Today, Net Insight partners with hundreds of customers in over 70 countries to ensure media flows across managed and unmanaged IP networks, and the cloud – from anywhere, to everywhere. It enables customers to get the best from any mix of virtualized, cloud and IP technology and is the only platform to support all the major industry standards, protocols and clouds.*

*Welcome to Net Insight, where* ***innovation****,* ***collaboration****, and* ***trust*** *are the cornerstones of our success. As one team, we are committed to delivering value to our customers, contributing to the growth and success of our company. Together we create a dynamic and positive workplace where everyone is valued, engaged and empowered to make an impact*

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**


You will be joining a team focused on predicting the near-future demand for our vehicles. Specifically, where and when they will be needed, and how to handle this at scale for a fleet of 150 thousand vehicles spread across over more than 100 cities. This is a complex and meaningful problem from both an analytical as well as an engineering perspective, and you'll be handed ambiguous, high-leverage problems and are expected to reason from first principles about what to build — not a spec to implement.


As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Voi, you'll work closely with a small, cross-functional team to design, build and maintain machine learning models. You will work on problems where you will get to utilize your skills in such interrelated disciplines as machine learning, AI engineering, software engineering, data science, optimization as well as data engineering.

*Your responsibilities will include:*

* Own and contribute to end-to-end machine learning and AI projects, in close collaboration with business stakeholders, and the rest of your team
* Formulating solution hypotheses, defining data requirements, prototyping, implementing in production, and continuously monitoring model health and business impact
* Maintain and improve Voi's machine learning platform to ensure our machine learning products adhere to state-of-the-art MLOps standards, with support from the team
* Work with colleagues to improve team processes and support mutual learning and knowledge sharing

**WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK**


We’re looking for a Machine Learning professional with experience from a fast-paced environment. In addition to being fluent in English, we believe the right person has:

* A clear focus on business value and user impact
* A strong analytical mindset, and comfortable setting up simplified first-principles models for complex problems, built on well-thought-through assumptions
* Forward-leaning attitude towards LLM-based and agentic approaches: you explore new AI tooling before it’s obviously the standard, and pair that curiosity with strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
* Experience contributing to projects from start to finish, from understanding business challenges to planning, building, launching and following up on results
* Hands-on experience with real-time inference and/or MLOps in one of the major cloud environments
* Experience writing production-quality, maintainable software
* Higher education in one of the mathematical sciences such as computer science, mathematics, physics, bioinformatics or with a similar data-centric degree

*Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.*

**WHY VOI?**


Working at Voi is more than just a job; our People Promise includes a personal voyage where you will grow as a professional and be a part of a team and culture that builds something meaningful for society. In addition to this you’ll have the opportunity to:

* Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest growing scale-ups
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office
* Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution

title: Revenue Enablement Specialist
description:
**Xensam:** Join the Future of SAM Xensam is the leader in AI-powered, cloud-based Software Asset Management. Our technology brings clarity to complex IT environments, helping users make smart, data-driven decisions and maximize software ROI.
  
Recognized with the Highest Growth Award and ranked #3 Overall Champion at the Main Software 50 Awards Nordics, we’re scaling fast and looking for people who want to join the journey. In this role, you will create and deliver the content, training, and resources that help our Business Development, Sales, and Customer Success teams succeed. From sales playbooks and learning materials to workshops and onboarding, you will help turn knowledge into practical tools that teams can use every day.
  
You will join our growing Revenue Operation and Enablement team and will work closely with teams across Revenue, Marketing, and Product to understand where support is needed, identify gaps, and continuously improve how we enable our teams.

Create and maintain sales playbooks, learning materials, battlecards, job aids, and other enablement content
  
  

Help teams get more value from enablement tools, including conversational intelligence and CRM features
  
  

Track the adoption and impact of enablement content, programs, and tools
  
  

Gather feedback from GTM teams to identify content gaps and training needs
  
  

Work with Revenue Operations to use data and insights to identify where enablement can have the greatest impact
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

Experience working with B2B SaaS go-to-market teams, such as Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, or Account Management
  
  

Good understanding of B2B SaaS sales processes, methodologies, or qualification frameworks
  
  

Excellent written and spoken English
  
  

Clear and engaging communication and presentation skills
  
  

Strong ability to collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Product, and other teams
  
  

Experience creating learning, training, or educational content for others
  
  

Ability to turn complex information into clear, practical, and actionable content
  
  

A structured and conscientious approach to your work
  
  

Curious, open to feedback, and motivated to continuously learn and improve
  
  

Bonus points if you have
  
  

Previous experience in Revenue Enablement
  
  

Knowledge of instructional design or adult learning principles
  
  

What you get
  
  

A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more.
  
  

Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).
  
  

An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.
  
  

A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".
  
  

If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip.
  
  

Other location-specific benefits.
  
  

Our values at Xensam
  
Rebellious We challenge the norm and act with initiative – always with responsibility.
  
Humane We foster a caring, inclusive environment that values diversity and respects individuality.
  
Harmony We value balance and create a supportive workplace where people thrive.
  
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on final candidates to fulfill our commitments to customers and ensure a safe work environment.

title: Principal Architect, Google Cloud
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience as an enterprise architect or equivalent experience in a customer-facing role.
* Experience in cloud market insights and cloud computing across applications, infrastructure, storage, platforms, or data.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with structured enterprise architecture practices, hybrid cloud deployments, and on-premise-to-cloud migration deployments and roadmaps.
* Experience in enterprise technology buying and evaluation process paired with a understanding of computing solutions and in building, architecting, designing and implementing highly distributed global cloud-based systems.
* Knowledge of technology solutions and ability to learn and work with new emerging technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the Cloud/IT technology space.
* Ability to deliver results and work cross-functionally to position and orchestrate a solution consisting of multiple products.
* Ability to drive and influence audiences and identify expansion engagements within accounts.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  

  

As part of the Customer Engineering organization in Google Cloud, you will lead cross-functional teams of experts to help customers design, plan, implement, and govern enterprise cloud strategies.  

  

The Google Cloud Principal Architect role is a hybrid technical and business advisor role. In this role, you will embody executive level qualities, lead the conversation, and direct the execution of the sales team by combining both technical goals and business insight. You will partner with Value Engineering to articulate the true total value of each technical solution and the overall business partnership with Google Cloud.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

Sweden: kr1560000 - kr1590000 (SEK) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits

* Build a trusted advisory relationship with strategic accounts and engage with Architects, VP Engineering, CTO and CIO, and identify customer priorities, technical objections and design strategies encompassing the entire Google ecosystem to deliver business value and resolve blockers.
* Provide domain expertise around public cloud and enterprise technology, and effectively promote Google Cloud with customers, at conferences, and online.
* Make recommendations on integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution while providing best practices to customers to optimize Google Cloud effectiveness.
* Manage the holistic enterprise architecture relationship with customers by collaborating with specialists, product management, technical teams, and more.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required (can vary, on average ~50%).

title: Cloud Software Test Engineer - Custom Object Training (COT), Lund
description:
**Job Title**
-------------


Cloud Software Test Engineer - Custom Object Training (COT), Lund**Job Description**
-------------------

*Are you an experienced test engineer eager to secure the cloud services that turn AI potential into real-world insights? Do you thrive in a collaborative team and have a passion for Python, test automation, and validating self-service machine learning training pipelines? Our team is looking for a test engineer to help us ensure exceptional quality, scalability, and reliability across our analytics platform.*

**Who is your future team?**


Meet the team behind Custom Object Training (COT): a cutting-edge cloud service that lets customers train cameras to recognize anything they need. We’re on a mission to turn complex AI training into a seamless, self-service experience. Bringing this to life is a tight-knit, cross-functional crew of software experts, AI specialists, full-stack developers—and now, you.


Our tech stack is modern and cloud-native: Python is used for the core logic and orchestration, React for the user interface, and modern cloud data services for the data and metadata storage. We view quality as everyone's responsibility, not a siloed task. From code to customer, we build together, own our solutions end-to-end, and champion an environment of fast feedback and continuous growth.

**What will you do as a Cloud Software Test Engineer?**


Driving test automation and securing our AI training-as-a-service (aaS) platform will be your core mission. Testing a cloud-native machine learning service brings a unique edge: you will master the probabilistic behaviour of ML models while ensuring our self-service workflows, data pipelines, and API contracts remain rock-solid.


Your tasks will include:

* Designing, developing, and executing test automation frameworks (primarily using Python) for complex cloud services and AI training workflows.
* Testing end-to-end user flows—from data ingestion and model training triggers in the cloud to deployment and validation on edge devices.
* Validating data quality and data flows, ensuring our system handles edge cases, sensor noise, anomalies, and schema changes gracefully.
* Implementing both functional and non-functional test cases, including handling scalability, latency, failover scenarios, and network instability.
* Collaborating closely with developers to ensure strong API contracts, backward compatibility, and robust observability (metrics, logs, and tracing) in production.
* Championing quality best practices within the team to maintain fast feedback loops and keep CI/CD pipelines efficient.

**Who are we looking for?**


We are looking for an experienced, pragmatic test engineer with a deep background in cloud-native software quality. You recognize that in data-driven analytics platforms, data truly is the product—and you bring a sharp eye for balancing automated regression tests with the unique challenges of testing probabilistic AI models.


We'd love to hear that you have:

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.
* Solid professional experience in software testing, test automation, and building robust test frameworks within cloud-native environments.
* A strong grasp of AI and machine learning concepts—specifically how neural networks train, the critical impact of data quality and diversity, and statistical approaches to evaluating model performance.
* Strong programming skills with advanced proficiency in Python, alongside familiarity with other programming and scripting languages.
* Hands-on technical experience with Linux environments, version control (GIT), REST APIs, databases, and modern cloud/CI/CD tools (such as Jenkins and Docker).
* Good understanding of network communication, protocols (such as RTSP and HTTP), and how cloud services interact with embedded edge systems.
* Fluency in English, with great communication skills. Knowledge of Swedish is a plus.

**Who is your future** **manager****?**


As your manager, I believe in empowering you to take ownership of your work, with the freedom to make choices and decisions responsibly. I lead through coaching, fostering a collaborative and informal team dynamic where everyone feels heard. At its core, leadership is about more than just managing others - it's about taking initiative and driving change. In fact, I think leadership is in everyone - stepping up, showing the courage to act, and inspiring others to do the same. For me, the greatest reward is seeing our team flourish and knowing that I've played a part in helping each of you reach your full potential. And let's not forget - all of this happens with a healthy dose of humor and a commitment to having fun along the way!

 **What Axis have to offer**


We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

*Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “**fika**” chats, formal meetings,* *or after-hours activities.* *Check it out:* *Axis HQ*


Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.


To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:

Innovation at Axis

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.


We go through applications continuously so don’t wait – send in your application today!

title: Security Engineer
description:
**About Us**
------------


Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.  

  

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.  

  

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$100M+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.  

  

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.  

  

Joining Legora means three things.

* We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.


If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

**The role:**


At Legora, security is the foundation of the trust our customers place in us. The world’s leading law firms, as well as some of the biggest corporations use our platform for their most sensitive matters, and we need security to be built into how we design, ship, operate, and scale.


We are looking for exceptional Security Engineers who can build leverage across a large surface area: a multi-tenant AI platform, a multi-cloud estate with Azure as our primary cloud, and an engineering organisation that ships fast. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will own security work end to end, build tooling and guardrails, embed with engineering teams, and make the secure path the default path.


We hire T-shaped security engineers. You should bring real depth in one of Application Security, Detection Engineering & Response, or Cloud & Platform Security, while staying credible across the others. Tell us in your application which area is your specialisation.

*This role can be based in Stockholm or New York. It is a 5-day in-office role, we believe building together in person drives better outcomes.*

**What you will be doing:**

* Own security work end to end: architecture, tooling, roadmap, and outcomes.
* Work embedded with engineering teams to make secure design, development, and operations the default.
* Build and ship software: guardrails, detections, libraries, automation, and workflows that live in git, are reviewed, tested, and deployed through CI/CD.
* Raise the security bar across engineering through design reviews, threat modelling, tooling, and enablement.
* Fix the class of bug, not just the instance, by turning findings into patterns, defaults, or detections.
* Secure a multi-tenant AI platform, including identity, authorisation, tenant isolation, data handling, and model-facing attack surfaces.
* Build with LLMs and agents, and help secure code and workflows produced at agent speed.
* Respond to incidents and write post-mortems that lead to meaningful technical and organisational improvements.

**Your specialisation:**

* **Application Security:** Threat model features and architectures, review high-risk changes across authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation, and data handling, and secure AI and agentic product features against prompt injection, tool-use abuse, data exfiltration, and related attack paths.
* **Detection Engineering & Response:** Own detection-as-code, security data pipelines, abuse and account-compromise detection, and incident response across corporate and product surfaces. Build the agents that run first-pass triage and investigation, plus the guardrails and evals that make their output trustworthy. No tiered queue.
* **Cloud & Platform Security:** Harden identity, access, cloud control planes, CI/CD, supply chain, infrastructure-as-code, AKS baselines, tenant isolation primitives, and least-privilege access for engineers, workloads, and AI agents.

**Who you are:**

* Several years of engineering experience in your security specialisation, with real depth in vulnerabilities you have found, incidents you have run, systems you have hardened, or tooling you have built.
* You are an engineer who writes production-quality code; we work primarily in TypeScript/Node.js and Python.
* You are comfortable operating across application security, detection and response, and cloud/platform security, even if one of those areas is your main depth.
* You understand identity, authorisation, multi-tenancy, and where security boundaries tend to break.
* You communicate clearly, translate risk into engineering terms, and influence teams without relying on mandates.
* You are calm and structured under incident pressure, and honest afterwards.
* You are excited by a small team with a large surface area, where the right answer is usually to build leverage rather than create queues.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience securing LLM-based or agentic products.
* Experience building a security function at a high-growth SaaS company.
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS isolation models.
* Experience in environments with strict confidentiality, data residency, or professional secrecy requirements.
* Supply chain security depth, such as SLSA, artifact signing, or SBOMs.


If you are close but not a perfect match on the list, apply anyway and tell us what you would own.

**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**


At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**About Us**
------------


Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.  

  

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.  

  

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$100M+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.  

  

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.  

  

Joining Legora means three things.

* We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.


If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

**The Role**
------------


We're hiring a Procurement Manager in Stockholm to own sourcing, negotiation, and vendor management across our indirect spend: software and SaaS, cloud and infrastructure, data, professional services, marketing, and facilities.


We've scaled past $100M+ in ARR with teams across Europe, North America, and APAC, and our vendor spend and contract volume have grown faster than the process around them. This is the first dedicated procurement hire in Stockholm, reporting to the Procurement Director. You'll decide how we run competitive processes, how we negotiate, how we measure savings, and how teams get purchases through Legal, Security, and Finance without losing a week to it.


It's a hands-on individual contributor role with unusual latitude, and we expect you to work AI-first: a sharp operator with the right tooling should do what used to take a team. Every dollar you take out of a contract goes back into product and customers.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead strategic sourcing across our indirect spend categories — building the category view and deciding where we compete a purchase, consolidate, rightsize, or walk away.
* Run competitive sourcing events end to end: RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs with scorecards agreed up front, structured supplier evaluation, and award recommendations backed by a cost model.
* Own negotiation strategy on new purchases and renewals — pricing, volume tiers, ramps, payment terms, duration — and redline commercial terms alongside Legal.
* Own the renewal pipeline. Open every material renewal well ahead of expiry with usage data and market benchmarks in hand, and rightsize or consolidate instead of auto-renewing.
* Partner with Finance and FP&A on spend forecasting, license models tied to headcount planning, and budget impact.
* Partner with IT, Security, and Legal on vendor diligence and data protection review, keeping purchasing compliant with our policies and our customers' security requirements — on a timeline teams can plan around.
* Manage supplier relationships and performance after signature, running reviews against agreed service levels and making the call to renew, renegotiate, or exit.
* Analyze spend, demand, and benchmark data to surface savings through consolidation, contract restructuring, and rightsizing, and report realized savings and cost avoidance to leadership.
* Use AI as leverage across benchmark research, contract and clause review, spend analysis, negotiation prep, and first-draft business cases — and build the checks that make the output trustworthy to the rest of the business.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Experience:** 2+ years in procurement, strategic sourcing, or another analytically rigorous commercial role such as consulting, banking, or finance and business operations. Software and SaaS spend preferred.
* **Negotiation:** A track record on real agreements you can walk through end to end: what you targeted, what you traded, and what it saved.
* **Commercial judgment:** You can read an agreement and spot the terms that cost money later, including auto-renewals, uplift caps, true-up mechanics, and termination rights.
* **AI fluency:** AI is your default first step, not a novelty you tried once. You can show what you've automated and how you verify the output before you rely on it.
* **Analytical rigor:** Strong in Excel or Sheets, comfortable modeling spend scenarios and total cost of ownership, and able to build a business case you'd present to a CFO without hedging.
* **Stakeholder management:** You influence without authority across Legal, Security, IT, Engineering, and Finance, and you give and take direct feedback without ego.
* **Process instinct:** You'd rather design the scalable system than patch the same manual step every week.
* **Ownership and pace:** You make the call when no policy covers it, then write the policy. You chase the answer instead of escalating the question.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with Zip
* Experience on large, complex agreements: cloud and infrastructure commitments (AWS, GCP, Azure), enterprise SaaS agreements, or multi-year data and model provider deals.
* Vendor security and privacy review fluency: SOC 2, ISO 27001, and DPAs, and a view on which parts actually matter.

**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**


At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Penetrations testare
description:
Vi söker en penetrationstestare som tänker som en angripare, men jobbar på rätt sida av lagen.

Du vet känslan när du ser en ny applikation och första tanken inte är "vad gör den?" utan "hur tar jag mig in?".

Då kanske du passar hos oss.

På Certezza hjälper vi organisationer att hitta sina svagheter innan någon annan gör det. Vi söker nu en penetrationstestare eller red team-specialist som älskar tekniska utmaningar, gillar att gräva där andra ger upp och som ser säkerhetsbrister där andra ser funktioner.

Vad kommer du göra?

Kort sagt: försöka ta dig in där du inte borde kunna.

Mer konkret innebär det att du:

* Genomför penetrationstester och säkerhetsgranskningar
* Simulerar verkliga angreppsscenarier
* Identifierar sårbarheter och risker
* Dokumenterar resultat och rekommenderar åtgärder
* Presenterar dina slutsatser för både tekniker och beslutsfattare

Du kommer att arbeta med allt från webbapplikationer och interna nätverk till molnmiljöer och andra komplexa system.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du:

* Har några års erfarenhet av penetrationstester
* Trivs i Linux lika bra som i Windows
* Förstår nätverk, webbteknik och moderna IT-miljöer
* Är nyfiken, analytisk och kreativ
* Tycker att lärandet aldrig tar slut

Bonuspoäng om du har erfarenhet av bug bounty, reverse engineering, cloud security, mobilsäkerhet, exploit-utveckling, OSINT eller forensik.

Och om förkortningar som OWASP, CVE, MITRE och NIS inte kräver någon googling är det ett gott tecken.

Varför Certezza?

För att du får:

* Arbeta med några av Sveriges mest spännande säkerhetsuppdrag
* Kollegor som gärna delar kunskap istället för att vakta den
* Tid och möjlighet att utvecklas och certifiera dig
* Stor frihet under ansvar
* En kultur där människor är lika viktiga som tekniken

Vi har över 20 års erfarenhet inom cybersäkerhet och fortsätter att växa. Nu vill vi gärna göra det tillsammans med dig.

Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare  
Placering: Stockholm

Vi intervjuar löpande och ser fram emot din ansökan.

title: Agentic AI Solution Specialist
description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom Applications team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda, skalbara och säkra cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation. AI är en nyckelteknologi i allt vi gör och en central del i hur vi formar och bygger moderna system och lösningar, där intelligenta AI-drivna arbetssätt och teknologier som Agentic AI driver utvecklingen framåt. Bli en del av oss och var med och forma framtidens system tillsammans med världsledande organisationer och bidra till att frigöra teknikens fulla potential i en mer hållbar och inkluderande värld!


**Din roll**
  

Som Agentic AI Solution Specialist blir du en drivande kraft i att forma framtidens intelligenta automation. Du kommer att arbeta nära våra kunder för att identifiera affärsmöjligheter och omsätta dem till robusta, agentbaserade AI-lösningar. Rollen är konsultativ och kombinerar tekniskt djup med affärsmässighet – du är både rådgivare och inspiratör. *I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i:*


* Driva kundprojekt inom Agentic AI och intelligent automation från idé till leverans.
* Agera senior advisor i strategiska initiativ och projekt som rör Agentic AI, och bidra med expertstöd i komplexa frågor.

**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas**

* En kultur som uppmuntrar innovation, kompetensutveckling och kunskapsdelning, där du får utrymme att leda förändring och skapa verklig impact.
  

  

**Ansökan**
  

*Efter att du skickat in din ansökan gör vi en första urvalsbedömning. Därefter följer en telefonintervju med ansvarig Talent Acquisition Partner, en intervju med rekryterande chef på kontoret och en teknisk intervju där vi går djupare in på din kompetens. Du kommer löpande kunna ställa frågor och få uppdateringar från ansvarig Talent Acquisition Partner – vårt mål är att skapa en positiv upplevelse där du får en rättvis bild av både rollen och oss som arbetsgivare.*

title: Grafisk formgivare
description:
***Ett vanligt jobb. Fast mer wiiie!***  

*Sedan 1923 har vi fått människor att mötas, skratta och trivas tillsammans. Snart är det din tur att vara med. Hos oss jobbar du inte bara i en nöjespark – du jobbar i en hel värld av upplevelser: Karuseller, musik, god mat, hotell, show, trädgårdar, camping – och snart en helt ny vattenvärld. Vi har öppet året om, i olika säsonger och olika tempo – men glädjen finns alltid där. Och det är just du som är med och skapar den. Här är jobbet både stort och smått, vardagligt och wiiie, fullt av fart men med plats för eftertanke. Ett vanligt jobb. Fast mer wiiie!*

 **Vi ger dig detta (och lite till!)**

* **Vardag och wiiie**. Här är jobbet både kul och på riktigt. Du gör skillnad – oavsett om du jobbar mitt i pulsen eller bakom kulisserna.
* **Kollegor och kvarterskänsla.** Här finns experter på allt från snurrande åk till smarta excel-dokument. Olika jobb, olika hörn av samma varma kvarter.
* **Värde före vinst**. Vi ägs av staden. Det du gör bidrar till något större än oss själva.
* **Mod och metod.** Vi testar nytt – men alltid med hållbarhet i fokus. Att ligga i framkant kräver både idéer och eftertanke. Här finns båda.


Nu söker vi en grafisk formgivare som vill vara med och utveckla ett av Sveriges starkaste och mest älskade varumärken.

 **Du är en i gänget**


Marknadsavdelningen är en del av verksamhetsområde Kommersiell. Vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att kommunicera mot alla målgrupper, driva försäljning och stärka varumärket längs hela kundresan – från första inspiration till återaktivering.


Inom marknadsavdelningen arbetar vi med hela Lisebergs erbjudande – parkens säsonger, mat & dryck, boende, scenupplevelser – och våra största satsningar någonsin: Liseberg Grand Curiosa Hotel och vattenvärlden Liseberg Oceana.


Du blir en del av Studio, vårt kreativa team där AD, copywriter, grafisk formgivare, filmproducent och andra kreativa specialister arbetar tillsammans för att skapa kommunikation som engagerar, inspirerar och får människor att vilja uppleva Liseberg.

 **Så ser en vanlig dag ut**


Som grafisk formgivare ansvarar du för att utveckla, formge och producera kommunikation som stärker Lisebergs varumärke i alla kanaler. Du arbetar med allt från stora kampanjer och digital kommunikation till trycksaker, skyltning och andra visuella uttryck. Rollen kombinerar kreativt idéarbete med hög kvalitet i genomförande och ett viktigt ansvar för att utveckla och förvalta Lisebergs visuella identitet.


Dagens to-do: skapa magi, genom att:

* Stödja verksamheten med specialistkompetens inom grafisk form och visuell kommunikation.
* Formge, producera och ta fram original, layout och produktionsunderlag för digitala och tryckta kanaler.
* Anpassa grafiskt material för olika målgrupper, kanaler och format.
* Säkerställa att all kommunikation följer Lisebergs grafiska profil, designsystem och visuella riktlinjer.
* Bidra med kreativ kompetens från idé till färdig leverans i nära samarbete med projektledare, art director, copywriter och övriga specialister.
* Förvalta och vidareutveckla Lisebergs visuella identitet, grafiska riktlinjer, mallar och gemensamma designresurser samt stödja verksamheten i tillämpningen.
* Vara administrativt huvudansvarig inom marknadsteamet för varumärkesriktlinjer och digitala assets på Lisebergs digitala plattform (mediebank) samt stödja kollegor i användning och utveckling av plattformen.
* Bidra till planering, samordning och genomförande av kommunikationsinsatser inom arbetsområdet.

 **Passar vi ihop?**  

Hos oss på Liseberg är ensam inte stark och att sätta kollegor och gäster i första rummet är för dig en självklarhet. Vi söker dig som delar våra värdeord; omtanke, kreativitet, säkerhet, kvalitet och glädje och med dessa vill du vara med och skapa Liseberg.

 **Har du vad som krävs för åkturen?**

* Relevant utbildning inom grafisk design, visuell kommunikation eller motsvarande.
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av professionell grafisk formgivning.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud, särskilt InDesign, Illustrator och Photoshop.
* Mycket god känsla för typografi, färg, bild, form och layout.
* Erfarenhet av både digital och tryckt produktion.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med grafiska profiler och varumärkesstyrning.
* Erfarenhet av plattformen Frontify är meriterande.
* Erfarenhet av tillgänglighetsanpassning är meriterande.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.


Som person är du kreativ, nyfiken och kvalitetsmedveten. Du har en stark känsla för kommunikation, form och detaljer, arbetar strukturerat och trivs med att driva ditt arbete framåt. Samtidigt är du en prestigelös lagspelare som uppskattar nära samarbeten och gärna delar med dig av din kompetens.

title: Data & AI Product Owner - Geely Europe Innovation and Collaboration AB
description:
**Explore the exciting world of Geely Holding Group.** Over the past three decades of development, Geely Holding Group has transformed into a global innovative technology group engaged in the design, R&D, production, sales, and service of vehicles, powertrains, and key components, as well as mobility services, digital technology, financial services, and education. Developing cutting-edge technologies in everything from new energy to low orbit satellites as we lay the foundation for a future multi-dimensional mobility ecosystem.


Headquartered in Hangzhou, Geely Holding today has a number of invested companies including Lynk & Co, Zeekr, Geely Auto, Volvo Cars, Polestar, Lotus, London Electric Vehicle Company, Farizon Auto, and much more. In Europe, Geely Holding is represented by Geely Sweden Holdings located in Gothenburg.


Geely Europe Innovation & Collaboration AB is a shared competence and service center for Geely companies in Sweden and Europe. Providing expertise and support in staff functions such as IT, HR, Legal, Finance, Tax, Real Estate Development and Facility Management.


We are currently seeking a Data & AI Product Owner to join our IT team. This is an opportunity to join a unique professional journey that combines the best of two worlds, being part of a specialized organization in a larger multicultural context.

###### **Your new adventure awaits!**


The primary objectives of this role is to define and drive the product vision, strategy, roadmap and prioritization for the EU Data & AI platform and related services.

* Lead and coordinate deliveries across data platforms, data products, connected vehicle data services, enterprise data, market, sales and service solutions, as well as AI initiatives.
* Translate business needs and opportunities into clear product requirements, backlog items, delivery plans and release priorities.
* Drive AI initiatives and enable the implementation of AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
* Collaborate closely with business, engineering, architecture, cloud, information security and data privacy teams to ensure solutions meet business, operational and regulatory requirements.
* Support the design and evolution of scalable data products and services, including data pipelines, APIs, analytics and AI-enabled solutions.
* Take ownership of project and delivery follow-up, including scope, progress, risks, dependencies and blockers.
* Lead team setup, competence development, resource planning and recruitment activities.
* Contribute to budget planning and resource allocation for current and future platform and service development.
* Establish and continuously improve ways of working, governance routines, documentation, delivery follow-up and Jira workflows.
* Manage access and permissions across relevant platforms and tools, including AWS, Databricks, Jira, Teams, Confluence and other data applications.
* Provide clear stakeholder communication, reporting and decision support across multiple organizations and cross-functional teams.


We are looking for someone who combines strong product leadership with a solid understanding of data, AI and modern technology platforms and also have experience with:

* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Information Management or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* **5+ years of experience** in Product Owner, Product Manager or similar roles within data, analytics, digital products or data platform environments.
* Proven experience leading or coordinating complex data products, analytics solutions, AI initiatives or data platform deliveries.
* Experience driving AI initiatives and implementations for enterprise use cases.
* Good knowledge of modern cloud-based data ecosystems and technologies such as **AWS, Databricks or Snowflake, BI/reporting tools and data integration services**.
* A strong understanding of the end-to-end data lifecycle, including ingestion, transformation, modelling, consumption, governance and operational support.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies, backlog management, sprint planning, prioritization and Jira-based workflows.
* The ability to translate complex business problems into scalable data products and technology solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and experience working across business, technical and management levels, preferably in an international environment.
* Knowledge of data governance, documentation, access management, information security and EU data compliance requirements.
* Experience with team leadership, resource planning and supplier or partner coordination is a strong advantage.
* A structured and analytical mindset, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive progress in a fast-changing environment.
* Experience from the **automotive industry** is highly valuable, particularly within connected vehicle data, diagnostics, quality, sales and marketing, aftersales or enterprise data analytics.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English. **Chinese is considered a plus.**


Geely Europe Innovation and Collaboration AB is situated within Geely's state-of-the-art innovation campus, Uni3 by Geely, at Lindholmen in Gothenburg. Here, you will enjoy working in an organization where a collaborative and dynamic work environment foster creativity and efficiency.


At Geely Europe Innovation and Collaboration AB we value individuals who bring an analytical mindset, self-motivation, and strong confidence to our dynamic and adaptable team. Whether working independently or collaboratively, your self-motivation, strong customer service skills, and proactive approach will be highly valued and appreciated. Building and nurturing strong business relationships is a fundamental aspect of our company culture. Embrace the absence of fixed structures and contribute to our vibrant and flexible setting, where your ideas and contributions truly matter.

###### **Where East meets West**


We are proud of our truly multicultural environment. Our organization brings together colleagues from many different nationalities and professional backgrounds. We believe diversity strengthens our decisions, creativity, and performance.


At Geely, traditions and cultures meet — from Chinese New Year celebrations to Swedish Lucia — creating a workplace where global perspectives and local values coexist naturally.

**Apply now!**


Become part of a team where diversity flourishes, innovation thrives, and exciting possibilities await.


Apply today and join a journey of cultural exploration and personal fulfillment!


If you have any question please reach out to [manager name], hiring manager for this position, at [manager email]

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.
  
The position
  
We are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer who will play a critical role in ensuring that Cambio’s internal IT environment is stable, secure, scalable, future‑proof, and aligned with our business needs. This role combines architectural ownership with hands‑on engineering — meaning you will both design the infrastructure of tomorrow and support the operational needs of today.
  
You will be part of Cambio’s transformation journey as we move from a traditional on-premise setup toward a modern hybrid and platform driven infrastructure. This includes building the technical foundation that will support our products, enabling automation, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
  
In this role, you will join a team of four experienced colleagues and collaborate closely with departments across Cambio, including IT Operations, R&D and external partners. You will contribute to designing our future architecture, driving change initiatives, supporting operational teams, and shaping an infrastructure that enables Cambio to scale securely and efficiently. The position offers significant influence, growth opportunities, and the ability to tailor parts of the role around your own technical passions.
  
  

**We offer:**  

A key role in a transformation journey — be a part of making the shift from traditional on prem infrastructure to a modern hybrid, platform driven environment built on automation & containerization.
  
  

A technically diverse role — work hands on with OpenShift, hybrid cloud, automation frameworks, secure networking, virtualisation, and modern infrastructure patterns.
  
  

A collaborative environment — work closely with IT Operations, R&D and key external partners, ensuring infrastructure truly supports product development and business growth.
  
  

A role that grows with you — start hands on and gradually expand into more strategic responsibilities, depending on your interests and strengths. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own focus areas.
  
  

Examples of responsibilities within the role
  
Design scalable infrastructure solutions across on‑prem and hybrid environments.
  
  

Develop architecture patterns, technical roadmaps, and capacity plans.
  
  

Act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure issues.
  
  

Deploy, patch, and maintain core systems, networks, and virtual platforms.
  
  

Lead troubleshooting and root‑cause analyses and support test/acceptance environments.
  
  

Build and maintain scripts, tools, and automations to streamline operations.
  
  

Contribute to IaC and containerization.
  
  

Implement security controls across identity, access, servers, and endpoints.
  
  

Collaborate with Security and IAM to ensure compliance with standards and regulations.
  
  

Take end‑to‑end ownership of selected systems or infrastructure components.
  
  

Manage upgrades, lifecycle planning, documentation, and platform consistency.
  
  

About you
  
You are a positive, solution-oriented person who enjoys tackling challenges with curiosity and drive. You take initiative, stay forward leaning, and thrive in an environment where things are evolving. Collaboration comes naturally to you — you value teamwork and contribute to a supportive and open atmosphere.
  
You communicate clearly and constructively, whether you’re explaining technical concepts or discussing priorities with colleagues. You take responsibility for your work, follow through on commitments, and are comfortable acting both as an architect and an engineer — and together with your team ensures that actions and decisions support the development of a stable, secure, and scalable internal IT environment.
  
  

Requirements 
  
  

Experience from a similar role within infrastructure and operations, as a engineer or architect
  
  

Strong hands-on knowledge in Windows Server, AD/Azure AD, networking, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), storage, backup, monitoring
  
  

Ability to troubleshoot complex multi-layer issues
  
  

Experience with automation and scripting, preferably in PowerShell
  
  

Great communication skills in English & Swedish, both spoken and written
  
  

It's a bonus if you have
  
  

Experience building or integrating internal tools
  
  

Experience supporting internal IT environments and end users
  
  

Experience with self‑provisioning tools or platforms
  
  

**Place of employment:** Linköping or Stockholm
  
**Scope:** Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)
  
**Form of employment:** Permanent employment, 6 months trial period
  
**Additional Information:** The role involves access to sensitive data, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.
  
We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.
  
We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Receptionister för natt- och dagpass med erfarenhet från Opera, MEWS & HMS
description:
**Om jobbet:** Receptionist på varierande arbetsplatser i Stockholm. Vi bemannar Stockholms mest attraktiva hotell med alltifrån enstaka pass till längre uppdrag. Arbeta när det passar dig och på den arbetsplats du trivs bäst. Arbetet varierar om du arbetar själv på hotellet eller med kollegor. Tjänsten passar dig som vill kombinera med studier eller annat arbete.
  
Vem är du? Är du en nattuggla som trivs bäst när alla andra sover? Arbetar du kanske redan på ett hotell som nattreceptionist men vill arbeta extra under din lediga vecka? Eller vill du jobba några extra pass dagtid?
  
Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet från hotellreception och känner dig trygg med något av följande bokningssystem: Opera, Opera Cloud, Mews, Hotsoft, HMS. Som person ser vi att du är flexibel, serviceminded och ordningsam. Du behöver kunna kommunicera obehindrat på engelska i tal och skrift. Varför ska du jobba på RA Hospitality? Att jobba hos oss är framförallt väldigt roligt! Vem vill inte ha hundratals härliga kollegor och möjlighet att jobba på massor av spännande arbetsplatser?
  
Erfarenhet - Hos oss får du snabbt erfarenheter som annars tar flera år att uppnå. Jobba på allt från en till 30 olika arbetsplatser, hos oss finns alla möjligheter! Lär känna nya branschkollegor och skaffa dig ett brett nätverk i branschen!
  
Flexibelt schema - Jobba eller vara ledig? Hos oss får du sms-förfrågningar och väljer själv hur mycket, när och vart du vill jobba. Vi erbjuder både heltid, deltid och extraanställningar!
  
Personalaktiviteter - Få vänner för livet! Vi hittar på massa kul tillsammans för att stärka gemenskapen och visa vår uppskattning.
  
️‍ ️ Friskvård och förmåner – Vi erbjuder alla våra anställda oavsett anställningsgrad rabatterade träningskort. Vi erbjuder även rabatt på hotellvistelser i hela Norden!
  
Utbildning - Flera gånger per år anordnar vi utbildningar på olika nivåer. Vi har också ett samarbete med externa parter, bl.a. Restaurangakademien.
  
Trygga och bra villkor med kollektivavtal - Hos oss ingår allt, försäkring, pension och semesterersättning. Dessutom så får du en konkurrenskraftig lön samt tillägg för obekväma arbetstider.
  
Mer om oss RA Hospitality är Nordens ledande bemanningsföretag inom besöksnäringen. Vi har funnits i över 20 år och har kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö och Oslo. Vi bemannar, rekryterar och outsourcar personal till hotellkedjor, stjärnkrogar, företagsrestauranger, kommuner, konferensanläggningar, cateringföretag och stora Arenor.
  
Våra ledord är effektivitet, kvalitet, flexibilitet och omtanke.

title: Data Center Capacity Engineer
description:
Meta is seeking a Data Center Capacity Engineer to help ensure our global data center infrastructure can meet the demands of billions of users across Meta's family of apps and services. In this role, you will analyze server fleet utilization, model capacity demand, and partner with infrastructure, supply chain, and site operations teams to plan and deliver compute, storage, and network resources at scale. You will translate complex capacity signals into actionable deployment plans that keep Meta's data centers running efficiently and reliably.  

  

  

### **Data Center Capacity Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Fulfill capacity models that forecast compute, storage, and network demand across Meta's global data center fleet
* Analyze rack placement and delivery trends, and recommend corrective deployment actions
* Partner with supply chain, procurement, and site operations teams to align hardware delivery schedules with capacity timelines
* Translate capacity demands into rack-level deployment plans, coordinating with data center operations teams to execute against build-out milestones
* Build and refine data pipelines and dashboards to provide real-time visibility into fleet capacity delivery across global regions
* Identify systemic inefficiencies in capacity allocation and design process improvements to increase infrastructure utilization and reduce waste
* Collaborate with infrastructure engineering and product teams to incorporate new hardware generations and evolving workload requirements into capacity
* Communicate capacity risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders through written analyses and structured reviews
* Contribute to team-level capacity delivery methodology, tooling standards, and goal-setting to improve operational efficiency
* Leverage AI-assisted analysis and workflow automation to accelerate capacity modeling, anomaly detection, and reporting at scale

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in data center capacity planning, infrastructure operations, or site production engineering
* Experience delivering capacity models and demand forecasts for large-scale compute, storage, or network infrastructure
* Familiarity with server hardware lifecycle management, rack-level power and cooling constraints, and data center physical infrastructure planning

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with capacity planning for hyperscale or cloud data center environments spanning multiple geographic regions
* Experience building or improving capacity planning tooling, simulation models, or forecasting frameworks used across engineering organizations
* Experience working with data analysis tools and scripting languages (such as Python, SQL, or equivalent) to build capacity reporting pipelines and automate workflows
* Track record of identifying and driving infrastructure efficiency improvements that measurably reduced cost or improved utilization at fleet scale

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Senior Account Executive - Public Sector
description:
**Overview**  

As a Senior Account Executive at Microsoft, you will lead some of Sweden's most strategic public sector organizations through their digital transformation journeys. You will build trusted relationships with senior executives, develop long-term account strategies, and orchestrate cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and societal outcomes.

title: Revenue Enablement Specialist
description:

Xensam is the leader in AI-powered, cloud-based Software Asset Management. Our technology brings clarity to complex IT environments, helping users make smart, data-driven decisions and maximize software ROI.


Recognized with the Highest Growth Award and ranked #3 Overall Champion at the Main Software 50 Awards Nordics, we’re scaling fast and looking for people who want to join the journey. At Xensam, you play a key role in a team built on energy, focus, and positivity. We value experience, but even more, the person behind it.


Together, we build the future of SAM.

 **About the role**


We are looking for a Revenue Enablement Specialist to help our go-to-market teams perform at their best.


In this role, you will create and deliver the content, training, and resources that help our Business Development, Sales, and Customer Success teams succeed. From sales playbooks and learning materials to workshops and onboarding, you will help turn knowledge into practical tools that teams can use every day.


You will join our growing Revenue Operation and Enablement team and will work closely with teams across Revenue, Marketing, and Product to understand where support is needed, identify gaps, and continuously improve how we enable our teams.


You don't need previous Revenue Enablement experience to succeed in this role. We're looking for someone with the right mindset, strong communication skills, and relevant experience from a B2B SaaS go-to-market environment.

 **Responsibilities**

* Organize and manage enablement resources so they stay relevant, accessible, and easy to use
* Work closely with Product Marketing to support the adoption of buyer-facing content and resources
* Support the implementation of sales methodologies and frameworks across the revenue cycle
* Design and deliver training sessions, workshops, and onboarding for GTM teams
* Create and maintain sales playbooks, learning materials, battlecards, job aids, and other enablement content
* Help teams get more value from enablement tools, including conversational intelligence and CRM features
* Track the adoption and impact of enablement content, programs, and tools
* Gather feedback from GTM teams to identify content gaps and training needs
* Work with Revenue Operations to use data and insights to identify where enablement can have the greatest impact
 **Qualifications**

* Experience working with B2B SaaS go-to-market teams, such as Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, or Account Management
* Good understanding of B2B SaaS sales processes, methodologies, or qualification frameworks
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Clear and engaging communication and presentation skills
* Strong ability to collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Product, and other teams
* Experience creating learning, training, or educational content for others
* Ability to turn complex information into clear, practical, and actionable content
* A structured and conscientious approach to your work
* Curious, open to feedback, and motivated to continuously learn and improve

**Bonus points if you have**

* Previous experience in Revenue Enablement
* Knowledge of instructional design or adult learning principles
**What you get**

* A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more.
* Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).
* An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.
* A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".
* If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip.
* Other location-specific benefits.

**Our values at Xensam**
