title: Field Application Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**
 We build Radio Units (RUs) that work as high-speed, secure, jam-resistant data pipelines for defence and dual-use applications — the connective tissue for UAV C2, deployable 5G, and tactical awareness systems.
   

  

 Our pipeline is full of customers — defence primes, armed forces, industrial operators — who are excited about what our RU could do for them.
 **The bottleneck isn't interest. It's that we don't have enough hands to sit with those customers, understand their actual problem, build something that proves it, and spot the patterns before anyone else does so we can feed them into our product roadmap.** 
 That's the job. You'll be the person who turns "this is interesting, let's talk again" into "we've seen it work, here's a contract."
   

  

**What You'll Actually Do**
* Sit in rooms with customers — sometimes a defence prime's systems architect, sometimes a signals officer, sometimes both — and figure out what they actually need (which is rarely what they first asked for).
* Scope and build PoCs and demos that integrate our RU with whatever the customer cares about: cameras, radars, microphones, ground stations on one end; data lakes, AI tooling, C2 software on the other.
* Do the integration work end-to-end. That means wiring a physical kit on Monday, debugging a MAVLink message on Tuesday, writing Python to push sensor data into a customer's stack on Wednesday, and demoing the whole thing on Thursday.
* Travel to customer sites in the US and across Europe. Sometimes you'll deploy and run a demo in the field. Sometimes you'll spend a week embedded with a prime's engineering team.
* Feed what you learn back into product. The patterns you find — the integrations customers keep asking for, the operational constraints that keep showing up — are how we figure out what to build next.
* Work directly with our CEO on the highest-priority opportunities. Until our CCO is in seat, you'll be operating with a lot of autonomy and short feedback loops.


**What We're Looking For**
**This is a hybrid role — equally happy soldering a cable and writing the Python that ingests what comes out of it. We don't expect you to have done all of the below, but you should be credibly strong on most of it:**
* Full-stack engineering instincts. You've built things end-to-end and you don't wait for someone else to define the interface.
* Hardware comfort. RF, comms, sensors, embedded systems — you've been around it. You're not scared of an oscilloscope or a radio link budget.
* Software fluency. Python is table stakes. You've worked with data pipelines, APIs, and at least one of the things our customers care about: drone autopilots (MAVLink, STANAG 4586), sensor fusion, edge processing, AI/ML inference at the edge, ground control stations.
* Customer-facing presence. You can sit in front of a colonel, a procurement officer, or a prime's chief engineer and earn their trust. You don't need a script.
* A bias for shipping. You've built demos and prototypes under time pressure. You know the difference between "demo-good" and "production-good" and you make the right call for the situation.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Customer says something vague. You don't wait for it to get clearer — you go figure out what they actually mean.


 We're open on seniority. If you're 4 years in and exceptional, we want to talk. If you're 10 years in and want to be hands-on at a stage where what you build defines the company, we want to talk.
   

  

**Background that fits**
**This Is Illustrative, Not a Checklist**
* Integration engineers from drone, robotics, or autonomy companies (typically Payload Integration, Flight Software, Ground Systems, or Integration Engineers at Auterion, Tekever, Quantum Systems, and similar) who've done real customer integration work.
* Forward Deployed / Mission Engineers from neo-defence companies (typically FDEs or FDSEs at Palantir; Mission Operations, Mission Software, or Mission Deployment Engineers at Anduril; and equivalent customer-facing engineers at Shield AI, Tekever, or similar).
* Engineers from RF, comms, or satellite companies (typically Firmware, Baseband, RF Systems, or Systems Integration Engineers at Bittium, Sivers Semiconductors, Gapwaves, Ericsson, Mynaric, or comms divisions at Saab, Leonardo, L3Harris, and Thales).
* Ex-military signals, EW, or comms officers (Signals Officers, Communications Officers, Electronic Warfare Officers, or Combat Systems Engineers) who've moved into engineering roles and miss being close to operators.
* Engineers from defence primes' rapid prototyping or skunkworks teams (typically Capability, Systems, Prototyping, or Applied Research Engineers) who are tired of the pace.


**What We're Not Looking For**
* Solutions Engineers from SaaS who are used to a defined demo script and a clean handoff to a CSM.
* Pure researchers or lab engineers who haven't shipped to real users.
* Career salespeople with a technical veneer.
* People who need a fully scoped backlog before they can start.


**What You'll Get**
* A seat at the table while we build the commercial function from scratch. The PoCs you build will define our product roadmap and our first multi-million-euro contracts.
* Direct working relationship with the CEO and the rest of the founding team.
* Real customers from week one. We have live opportunities in UAV C2 and deployable 5G that need an FDE on them today.
* Equity that reflects the impact. You'll be one of the first commercial hires.
* Salary commensurate with experience — we'll calibrate to your level and the market.


 TERASi is a deeptech startup based in Stockholm, Sweden which offers unique components and packaging for high-frequency wireless applications.
   

  

 TERASi’s technology builds upon academic research at KTH Royal Institute of Technology and years of internal R&D. The company designs and manufactures all components from its Stockholm headquarters and now embarks upon a mission to scale their technology and bring it to mass markets.

title: Lösningsarkitekt ServiceNow
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
**Om Sopra Steria:**
 Sopra Steria är Europas ledande konsultföretag inom ServiceNow och digital transformation. Vi hjälper företag och organisationer att effektivisera sina verksamheter genom innovativa teknologilösningar. Med fler än 4000 ServiceNow-experter besitter vi marknadens största och mest framstående ServiceNow-team där får du möjligheten att arbeta med dem mest spännande projekten samt utvecklas i en dynamisk och framåtlutad arbetsmiljö. Nu tar vi nästa stora kliv och satsar ännu hårdare på vår ledande position inom ServiceNow. Hos oss får du chansen att vara med och driva utvecklingen framåt, forma framtidens lösningar och göra verklig skillnad. Vill du vara en del av vårt ledande team?
   

  

**Om rollen:**
 I rollen som lösningsarkitekt inom ServiceNow kommer du vara en central del i utvecklingen och designen av moderna lösningar för att effektivisera arbetsflöden och processer. Som Elite Partner för ServiceNow har vi en av Skandinaviens största och mest kvalificerade konsultgrupper med närmare 500 dedikerade experter. Vi söker nu en senior profil som kan ta en ledande roll i våra teamleveranser tillsammans med våra experter som utvecklar innovativa lösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter:**
* Designa och implementering avancerade lösningar inom ServiceNow.
* Ledande roll i att utveckla och konfigurera plattformen för att möta specifika krav och behov.
* Arbeta nära affärsavdelningar för att förstå och översätta deras verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar.
* Driva tekniska workshops och rådgivning gentemot kunder.
* Aktiv deltagande i agila team och förmåga att leda och inspirera.


**För att vara framgångsrik i rollen tror vi att du har:**
* Flerårig erfarenhet som arkitekt inom ServiceNow med uppsättning, implementering, utveckling och konfiguration inom plattformen.
* Expertis inom Javascript, HTML, SQL och ITIL.
* Vana av att arbeta i agila team.
* Relevanta certifieringar inom ServiceNow.
* Eftergymnasial utbildning.
* Flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


**Vi erbjuder:**
* En spännande arbetsmiljö hos Europas ledande ServiceNow-konsultbolag.
* Möjlighet att arbeta med innovativa lösningar och den senaste tekniken.
* Kompetensutveckling genom certifieringar, utbildningar och mentorskap.
* Hybrid arbetsmodell samt konkurrenskraftiga villkor och förmåner


**Om ServiceNow-teamet på Sopra Steria:**
 Sopra Steria är Nordens ledande expert inom ServiceNow – vi har den största och mest specialiserade kompetensen på marknaden. Vårt starka och sammansvetsade team levererar omfattande och högkvalitativa lösningar, där flera av våra erfarna ServiceNow-konsulter samarbetar för att maximera värdet för våra kunder. Vi drivs av innovation, samarbete och kunskapsutbyte – tillsammans sätter vi nya standarder och skapar framtidens digitala lösningar. Vill du arbeta med de bästa? Då är Sopra Steria platsen för dig.
   

  

**Om Sopra Steria:**
 Sopra Steria är en av Europas ledande aktörer inom digital transformation, med över 60 000 medarbetare i mer än 30 länder globalt. Vi driver innovation och hjälper företag och organisationer att effektivisera, utvecklas och skapa långsiktigt värde genom banbrytande teknologilösningar.
   

  

 Hos oss arbetar de främsta experterna inom sina områden i en dynamisk och framtidsorienterad miljö där samarbete, nytänkande och teknisk spetskompetens står i centrum.
   

  

**Ansökan:**
 Om du är redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och vara en del av en framstående arbetsplats, ansök genom att ladda upp ditt CV. Kontakta gärna ansvarig rekryterare, Teodor Nellvik (teodor.nellvik@soprasteria.com) eller Business Owner Mikael Kroglund (mikael.kroglund@soprasteria.com) för eventuella frågor om tjänsten.
   

  

 På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

**Välkommen till Sopra Steria - där din kompetens formar framtidens digitala lösningar!**

title: Core Software Engineer
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 Battlefield is a storied franchise renowned for uncompromising combat gameplay and all-out warfare, for over two decades. 100 million players and 5 billion hours played later, Battlefield Studios is defining the future of the first-person shooter with the biggest launch in franchise history with Battlefield 6, and a new era beginning with Battlefield REDSEC.
   

  

 United under the banner of Battlefield Studios, 4 world-class teams across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect have come together to focus on the future of the franchise, a connected Battlefield universe filled with immersive experiences built on our unique DNA.
   

  

 LET’S PUSH THINGS FORWARD
   

  

 DICE is a creative studio with offices in Stockholm and Gothenburg. We believe in the power of inclusion and welcome game creators from all backgrounds to collaborate with us as we unlock the potential for the future of Battlefield!
   

  

 We’re always pushing to be at the forefront of creative entertainment - blending digital art, design, and technology to push boundaries. Our collaborative culture is fueled by passion, driving innovation and making a positive difference for our players and community.
   

  

 At DICE, your ideas matter. We offer an inclusive space where you can thrive, be yourself, and grow alongside a team dedicated to making a meaningful impact to the world of gaming.
   

  

 We’re all-in on the future and our most ambitious Battlefield yet. Want to be part of something special? Read on.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Senior Core Software Engineer with experience writing high-quality and maintainable code in C++. We find added value in candidates with expertise in optimizing for CPU performance and memory usage, and low-level understanding of the console and PC platforms.
   

  

 We need your bravery to challenge existing ideas. You can identify the small things that make a big difference. You listen to other people's ideas, know how to embrace change, and you lead by example.
   

  

 Reporting into Technical Lead, you will be a part of ensuring the studio and our live titles to adopt new technology and always improve the way we work. As an engineer, your ideas and implementations will change how DICE creates games. From within DICE and EA, being in a driving partnership with the Frostbite development team, you will work with leading industry talent in one of the world's largest and leading game development communities.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Experience with C++
* Experience with optimizing for CPU performance and memory usage
* Experience with low level programming
* Experience debugging difficult bugs
* Motivated to achieve with an eye towards quality
* Good communicator


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Experience with game engines, art content pipelines and workflows


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Solution Architect E-Commerce
description:
**Information om rollen**
 Stelltec Växer! Med En Stark Efterfrågan På Våra Konsulter Och En Ambitiös Tillväxtplan Så Behöver Vi Stärka Upp Vårt Team Med Duktiga Arkitekter. Där Kommer Du Bland Annat Arbeta Med Att
   

  

* Översätta kommersiella mål till tydliga målarkitekturer kopplade till kundens tekniska roadmap och definiera tillhörande investeringsbehov.
* Definiera lösningar och integrationsmönster runt digital handel och relaterade områden (exempelvis PIM, CMS, PSP-integrationer, ERP och OMS).
* Definiera icke-funktionella mål (tillgänglighet, prestanda, säkerhet, kostnad) och säkerställa att designen uppfyller dem.
* Leda leverantörsutvärderingar och –upphandlingar (RFI/RFP), utforma leveransbeskrivningar och styra leveranskvalitet.
* Coacha produkt-, teknik- och säkerhetsteam med tydliga KPI:er och ansvar.


**Det Du Har Med Dig**

* Domänexpertis inom digital handel och relaterade områden som produktinformation, pris, kampanj, betalningar, orderflöden, orderuppfyllnad, returer etc.

* Praktisk erfarenhet av någon av de större plattformarna på den svenska marknaden (commercetools, Shopify Plus, Optimizely, SAP Commerce) eller liknande och/eller viktiga närliggande plattformar (Contentful/Sanity headless CMS eller system/processer inom OMS)
* Moln-/arkitektur-/säkerhetscertifieringar (exempelvis inom AWS/Azure/GCP).


**Vi Kan Erbjuda Dig**
* En nyckelroll som Solution Architect där du får mandat att påverka och forma våra kunders arkitektur och teknikstrategier inom digital handel.
* Möjligheten att arbeta nära beslutsfattare för att översätta affärsmål till konkreta målarkitekturer och roadmaps som skapar tydligt affärsvärde.
* Utmanande uppdrag hos marknadsledande företag där du får använda din expertis inom digital handel, integrationsmönster, dataflöden och tekniska ekosystem.
* Frihet att växa i en organisation med kort beslutsväg, högt tempo och stor entreprenörsanda – utan begränsningar av ett strikt hierarkiskt ramverk.
* Konkurrenskraftiga villkor och möjlighet att påverka Stelltecs fortsatta utveckling.
* En arbetsmiljö där kunskapsdelning, innovation och affärsutveckling står i centrum – kombinerat med sociala och inspirerande aktiviteter på vårt kontor vid Norrmalmstorg.


**På** 
**Stelltec får du …**
 …vara med och utveckla ett innovativt och nytänkande företag från start. Du handplockas till spännande uppdrag hos både svenska och internationella företag där din kunskap och genomförandekraft är avgörande. Samtidigt blir du en del av Newground Alliance – en stark allians av etablerade konsultbolag inom olika nischer. Här får du möjlighet att samarbeta, utvecklas och dela kunskap med över 280 erfarna konsulter.
   

  

 Våra konsulter bidrar med stor erfarenhet, djup kunskap och insikt i vad som krävs för att framgångsrikt genomföra programvaru-, plattforms- och teknikimplementeringar. Stelltec har den kompetens våra kunder behöver för att skapa momentum, driva affärsvärde och uppnå utmärkta resultat.
   

  

 Oavsett om Stelltec tar sig an en digital re-platforming, ett molntransformationsprojekt eller digitalisering av viktiga affärsprocesser, får vi det att hända på ett snabbt, effektivt och kostnadseffektivt sätt. Hantering av projekt, initiativ eller andra leveransfokuserade arbetsflöden är hjärtat i vår verksamhet, och vi tvekar aldrig att ta risker för att bevisa vårt värde.
   

  

 Läs mer på www.stelltec.se.
   

  

**Vi ingår i** 
**Newground Alliance**
 Newground Alliance är en allians av oberoende nischkonsultbolag som tillsammans skapar värdefulla synergieffekter. Alla bolag är ”sina egna” och drivs självständigt, men som konsult har du möjligheter att samverka med konsulter från övriga bolag, ta hjälp av experter och utbyta kunskap. Alla bolagen delar lokaler på Norrmalmstorg vilket skapar spontana och värdefulla möten i vardagen.
   

  

 We are a consulting company focused on IT delivery management. We are a team of experienced, delivery-focused IT consultants with the skills, know-how and passion for taking on our clients’ most challenging projects – maximizing the value of their IT investments. Read more at www.stelltec.se

title: Experienced healthcare IT experts, doers and leaders
description:
Experienced healthcare IT experts, doers and leaders strengthening Karolinska’s “CDR catalyst” integration and AI context initiative.
   

  

*We are looking for international top competence that can strengthen Karolinska’s “CDR catalyst” integration and AI context initiative. These positions are in the form of project recruitments that according to current Swedish regulations can last maximum 4 years. (If we announce permanent positions during that time, you are of course welcome to apply to those and switch form of employment.)*
* All of the positions (except the project leader one) can be performed mostly remote from anywhere in the world if you wish – provided you remotely can attend some meetings per week during Swedish business hours and also can travel to Stockholm some times per year and spend some consecutive days here.
* If you find these tasks exciting, but you are bound by other existing obligations we may for some positions also consider part time employments, and one or several shorter limited time contract periods that fit you and us. Such periods can start later during the initiative, but you are wise to apply already now, since application to this ad has an end date.


 Before applying to any of the positions you need to read the entire “CDR Catalyst” initiative available from: https://discourse.openehr.org/t/join-or-comment-cdr-catalyst-initiative-from-karolinska/16859 (öppnas i nytt fönster) since some of the filtering questions are based on your thoughts from reading it. Other questions are based on mandatory requirements.
   

  

 You are also expected to upload a CV (but no personal letter). We want a balanced expert team so interviews, relevant knowledge/expertise/experience and CVs carry a lot of weight in the selection process.
   

  

 We do have other ways to recruit and procure general IT-competence, including general AI competence, for example Region Stockholm IT Consultancy agreement (a DPS – dynamic purchasing system open to suitable firms to apply to at any time). So if you do not fit the specific requirements below, then please focus on getting your firm/employer to join that DPS rather than spending your and our time on an application here.
   

  

 Applicants should be aware of that, like at most university hospitals, we start with a backlog of unmet needs. The team will assist in continuously detecting and reducing bottlenecks (technical, organizational/way of work etc.) and in finding all sorts of ways to catalyze and safely speed up development both within the initiative and in related teams/projects. This can be done e.g. via better ways-of-work and via automation (including with AI when data can be well understood by AI).
   

  

 Experienced health IT project leader (1-2 positions)
   

  

****Purpose And Responsibilities:****
* Coordinate all stages of CDR Catalyst initiative by aligning technical delivery, resource planning, and stakeholder engagement.
* Build a project culture that combines rigorous semantic and architectural thinking with pragmatic, iterative progress and deliveries.
* The culture you build needs to be open-minded and safely harbor mixed thoughts, opinions and predictions about the rapidly shifting IT and medical/scientific landscape. You need to direct the initiative in a way that ensures that clinical teams and researchers can actually use the resulting systems, tools and data within reasonable time from when new needs surface.
* Coordinate the collaboration in the (likely international) core CDR Catalyst doer/builder/architect/informatics team and facilitate collaboration with other teams.
* Coordinate (and help recruit and adjust) the CDR Catalyst international strategic advisory board over different phases of the initiative.
* At times when the CDR catalyst initiative does not need your full attention and all working hours you will help leading or assisting other initiatives at the hospital and in the region


****Requirements****
* You are experienced in talking directly to clinical stakeholders, researchers, developers, architects and hospital/regional management. A lot of this communication will be in Swedish during meetings etc. (Even though most will know English very well.)
* You are experienced in leading teams of experts, getting them to jointly deliver value needed by stakeholders (including end users).
* You are usually available for weekly meetings in Stockholm (sometimes more often)
* You have a working proficiency in Swedish and English, so that you can participate in meetings and dialogues in Swedish and Enlgish.
* At least three years of verifiable experience leading health IT projects, preferably also complex ones.


**Meritorious**
* Verifiable long experience, educations and courses in health IT technologies/standards and related leadership


 Experienced health IT doers, builders, architects, informatics- and integration-specialists (2-5 positions)
   

  

 We Believe Some Of The Best Candidates For These Positions May Have Experience And Interest Covering Several Of The Roles Below. Thus The Questions For These Positions In The Ad Are Combined So You Can Describe Your Skills And Interests Instead Of Just Picking One Of Them:
   

  

* Senior clinical modeling experts and integration experts experienced in combinations of openEHR, FHIR, OMOP, SNOMED CT, ontologies, terminology binding etc. (We suspect most such experts are only available part time)
* Technological realization – smart doers/builders/toolmakers and AI expertise experienced in electronic health data, and/or “third AI-wave” combinations like neuro-symbolic solutions. With understanding for and interest in the goals expressed in the CDR Catalyst draft document.
* Semantic framework (knowledge graph etc.) strategist with deep openEHR and ontology-knowledge [One position for this role is in the process of being filled already when this ad is published, but we don’t mind more such experts if available full- or part-time]


****Requirements****
* Education and experience fitting the role(s) applied for (see questions)
* Remote or on site – ability to travel to Stockholm some times per year and spending some consecutive days here. And possibility to join remote meetings during some part of Swedish business hours 1-2 times a week. We’ll try adjust to time zones of team members if possible.


**Meritous**
* Existing provable deep multi-year engagement in health-IT standardization organizations, research and practical use.
* Experience in disciplined efficient use of AI-agents for creating and maintaining software and other information assets. For implementation we will use a lot of AI and you must be able to set up the work in control loops with verification etc so that delegation is safe and the balance between HTIL and automation is continuously being optimized.
* For Senior clinical modeling experts it is meritous to be very experienced in openEHR, terminology binding using SNOMED CT etc.


****About The Recruitment Process****
 Selection and interviews may be conducted on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 In our recruitment process, we may use Assessio's MAP and Matrigma tests. MAP is a personality test and Matrigma is a non-verbal cognitive ability test, both of which are based on research in occupational psychology. The tests are used to complement your experience and skills, and the purpose is to ensure our selection process is quality-assured and transparent.
   

  

 Regarding your application, you need to attach a CV and instead of a cover letter - we ask you to answer selection questions and briefly explain why you are a good fit for the role. Answering these questions is a prerequisite for your application to be considered complete.
   

  

 For permanent positions, a probationary period may apply.
   

  

**We warmly welcome your application - Together we are Karolinska!**

 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

(If we announce permanent positions during that time, you are of course welcome to apply to those and switch form of employment.)* 



* All of the positions (except the project leader one) can be performed mostly remote from anywhere in the world if you wish – provided you remotely can attend some meetings per week during Swedish business hours and also can travel to Stockholm some times per year and spend some consecutive days here.
* If you find these tasks exciting, but you are bound by other existing obligations we may for some positions also consider part time employments, and one or several shorter limited time contract periods that fit you and us. Such periods can start later during the initiative, but you are wise to apply already now, since application to this ad has an end date.



 Before applying to any of the positions you need to read the entire “CDR Catalyst” initiative available from:  https://discourse.openehr.org/t/join-or-comment-cdr-catalyst-initiative-from-karolinska/16859  since some of the filtering questions are based on your thoughts from reading it. Other questions are based on mandatory requirements. 
   

  





 You are also expected to upload a CV (but no personal letter). We want a balanced expert team so interviews, relevant knowledge/expertise/experience and CVs carry a lot of weight in the selection process. 
   

  





 We do have other ways to recruit and procure general IT-competence, including general AI competence, for example Region Stockholm IT Consultancy agreement (a DPS – dynamic purchasing system open to suitable firms to apply to at any time). So if you do not fit the specific requirements below, then please focus on getting your firm/employer to join that DPS rather than spending your and our time on an application here. 
   

  





 Applicants should be aware of that, like at most university hospitals, we start with a backlog of unmet needs. The team will assist in continuously detecting and reducing bottlenecks (technical, organizational/way of work etc.) and in finding all sorts of ways to catalyze and safely speed up development both within the initiative and in related teams/projects. This can be done e.g. via better ways-of-work and via automation (including with AI when data can be well understood by AI). 
   

  





**Experienced health IT project leader (1-2 positions)**




**Purpose and responsibilities:** 



* Coordinate all stages of CDR Catalyst initiative by aligning technical delivery, resource planning, and stakeholder engagement.
* Build a project culture that combines rigorous semantic and architectural thinking with pragmatic, iterative progress and deliveries.
* The culture you build needs to be open-minded and safely harbor mixed thoughts, opinions and predictions about the rapidly shifting IT and medical/scientific landscape. You need to direct the initiative in a way that ensures that clinical teams and researchers can actually use the resulting systems, tools and data within reasonable time from when new needs surface.
* Coordinate the collaboration in the (likely international) core CDR Catalyst doer/builder/architect/informatics team and facilitate collaboration with other teams.
* Coordinate (and help recruit and adjust) the CDR Catalyst international strategic advisory board over different phases of the initiative.
* At times when the CDR catalyst initiative does not need your full attention and all working hours you will help leading or assisting other initiatives at the hospital and in the region



**Requirements** 



* You are experienced in talking directly to clinical stakeholders, researchers, developers, architects and hospital/regional management. A lot of this communication will be in Swedish during meetings etc. (Even though most will know English very well.)
* You are experienced in leading teams of experts, getting them to jointly deliver value needed by stakeholders (including end users).
* You are usually available for weekly meetings in Stockholm (sometimes more often)
* You have a working proficiency in Swedish and English, so that you can participate in meetings and dialogues in Swedish and Enlgish.
* At least three years of verifiable experience leading health IT projects, preferably also complex ones.



**Meritorious** 



* Verifiable long experience, educations and courses in health IT technologies/standards and related leadership



**Experienced health IT doers, builders, architects, informatics- and integration-specialists (2-5 positions)**




 We believe some of the best candidates for these positions may have experience and interest covering several of the roles below. Thus the questions for these positions in the ad are combined so you can describe your skills and interests instead of just picking one of them: 
 


* Senior clinical modeling experts and integration experts experienced in combinations of openEHR, FHIR, OMOP, SNOMED CT, ontologies, terminology binding etc. (We suspect most such experts are only available part time)
* Technological realization – smart doers/builders/toolmakers and AI expertise experienced in electronic health data, and/or “third AI-wave” combinations like neuro-symbolic solutions. With understanding for and interest in the goals expressed in the CDR Catalyst draft document.
* Semantic framework (knowledge graph etc.) strategist with deep openEHR and ontology-knowledge [One position for this role is in the process of being filled already when this ad is published, but we don’t mind more such experts if available full- or part-time]



**Requirements** 



* Education and experience fitting the role(s) applied for (see questions)
* Remote or on site – ability to travel to Stockholm some times per year and spending some consecutive days here. And possibility to join remote meetings during some part of Swedish business hours 1-2 times a week. We’ll try adjust to time zones of team members if possible.



**Meritous** 



* Existing provable deep multi-year engagement in health-IT standardization organizations, research and practical use.
* Experience in disciplined efficient use of AI-agents for creating and maintaining software and other information assets. For implementation we will use a lot of AI and you must be able to set up the work in control loops with verification etc so that delegation is safe and the balance between HTIL and automation is continuously being optimized.
* For Senior clinical modeling experts it is meritous to be very experienced in openEHR, terminology binding using SNOMED CT etc.



**About the recruitment process**




 Selection and interviews may be conducted on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.
   

  





 In our recruitment process, we may use Assessio's MAP and Matrigma tests. MAP is a personality test and Matrigma is a non-verbal cognitive ability test, both of which are based on research in occupational psychology. The tests are used to complement your experience and skills, and the purpose is to ensure our selection process is quality-assured and transparent.
   

  





 Regarding your application, you need to attach a CV and instead of a cover letter - we ask you to answer selection questions and briefly explain why you are a good fit for the role. Answering these questions is a prerequisite for your application to be considered complete.
   

  





 For permanent positions, a probationary period may apply.
   

  





**We warmly welcome your application - Together we are Karolinska!**

title: Forward Deployed AI Scientist, Internship, Sweden - BCG X
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

**We Are BCG X**
 We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Our BCG X teams own the full analytics value-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI. Our product offerings span from fully custom-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions.
   

  

 You'll be part of our rapidly growing team who will have a chance to apply data science methods and analytics to real-world business situations across a variety of industries to drive significant business impact. You'll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like climate change, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions.
   

  

 Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X. Successful candidates are intellectually curious builders who are biased toward action, creative, and communicative.
   

  

 We Are Looking For Dedicated Individuals With a Passion For Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research And Redefining Organizations Into AI Led Innovative Companies. Successful Candidates Possess The Following
   

  

* Comfortable in a client-facing role with the ambition to lead teams
* Likes to distill complex results or processes into simple, clear visualizations
* Explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner
* Love building things and are comfortable working with modern development tools and writing code collaboratively (bonus points if you have a software development or DevOps experience)
* Significant experience applying advanced analytics to business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
* Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
* Have strong project management skills


 What You'll Bring
   

  

**Requirements**
 Currently enrolled in a university master’s or PhD degree program in Computer Research Science, Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
   

  

**Technologies**
 Programming Languages: Python
   

  

 #BCGXjob
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: D365 ERP Finance & Supply Chain Technical Architect
description:
**Sammanfattning**
 Som
 **ERP Technical Architec** 
 t hos oss kliver du in i en nyckelroll där du sätter den tekniska riktningen i några av våra mest affärskritiska och komplexa uppdrag inom
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management.**
 Du trivs i rollen som strategisk rådgivare, är trygg i dialogen med både IT och verksamhet och motiveras av att omvandla komplexa affärsutmaningar till skalbara, hållbara och innovativa lösningar. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser begränsningar – och du har förmågan att få med dig andra i din vision. Vi söker dig som vill ha verkligt inflytande.
   

  

 Du arbetar tillsammans med några av branschens främsta experter inom Microsoft Dynamics och digital transformation, i en kultur som präglas av samarbete, höga ambitioner och en stark vilja att skapa verkligt affärsvärde.
   

  

 Här får du utrymme att påverka, utvecklas och ta nästa steg i din karriär – samtidigt som du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Rollen ger dig möjlighet att arbeta hos Microsofts främsta partner, med fokus på innovation, ledarskap och leverans av lösningar med stort affärsvärde. Du äger den övergripande arkitekturen och sätter riktningen för hur lösningen ska designas, integreras och skalas över tid. Här får du kombinera tekniskt djup med strategisk påverkan.
   

  

 I denna roll leder du definitionen och leveransen av den övergripande tekniska ERP-lösningen, inklusive systemintegrationer samt rekommendationer av ISV-lösningar (Independent Software Vendors) eller andra best-of-breed-lösningar.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära intressenter för att definiera teknisk arkitektur, säkerställa att lösningen möter verksamhetens behov och driva strategier för digital transformation. Rollen kräver djup expertis inom Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management samt god kunskap om best practice inom teknisk arkitektur för att leverera skalbara, säkra och högpresterande lösningar.
   

  

**Together We Do What Matters.**
**Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden**
* Leda design av teknisk arkitektur för implementationer av Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management och säkerställa att lösningarna är i linje med affärsmål och tekniska best practices.
* Arbeta nära kunder, verksamhetsintressenter samt funktionella och tekniska team för att definiera lösningsroadmaps och arkitekturplaner.
* Ge vägledning kring best practice för affärskritiska ERP-lösningar, integrationer, säkerhet och styrning (governance).
* Designa komplexa integrationer mellan Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management och tredjepartsapplikationer med hjälp av Azure Integration Services, Dataverse och API:er.
* Ansvara för teknisk leverans och säkerställa att lösningarna är skalbara, högpresterande och följer Microsofts rekommenderade metoder.
* Leda teknisk arkitekturstyrning samt ha övergripande ansvar för utveckling och driftsättning.
* Mentorskap och coachning av tekniska team samt bidra till en kultur präglad av innovation och kvalitet.
* Hålla dig uppdaterad kring Microsofts senaste innovationer och bidra till interna initiativ för kunskapsdelning.


**Qualifications**
**Vi söker dig som har:**
* Flerårig erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management
* Erfarenhet av teknisk arkitektur och design av affärskritiska ERP-lösningar
* God kunskap om systemintegrationer, API, Dataverse och Azure Integration Services
* Erfarenhet av att leda tekniska team och driva tekniska beslut i komplexa projekt
* Förmåga att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till skalbara, säkra och hållbara lösningar
* Erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar och Microsoft Azure-plattformen
* God förståelse för säkerhet, governance och best practice inom ERP-arkitektur
* Erfarenhet av kunddialoger, workshops och arbete i nära samverkan med verksamhet och IT
* Ett konsultativt arbetssätt och förmåga att bygga starka relationer med kunder och kollegor
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska


**Personliga engeskaper som skapar framgång i rollen**
* Konsultativ, samarbetsinriktad och skicklig på att bygga relationer
* Uthållig, anpassningsbar och flexibel
* Intellektuellt nyfiken och genuint passionerad för teknik
* Övertygande kommunikatör och engagerad thought leader inom branschen.


**A great place to work**
 As you bring your skills and abilities to Avanade, you’ll get distinctive experiences, limitless learning, and ambitious growth in return. As we continue to build our diverse and inclusive culture, we become even more innovative and creative, helping us better serve our clients and communities. You’ll join a community of smart, supportive collaborators to lift, mentor, and guide you, and to lean on your expertise. You get a company purpose-built for business-critical, leading-edge technology solutions, committed to improving the way humans work, interact, and live. It’s all here, so take a closer look!
   

  

 We work hard to provide an inclusive, diverse culture with a deep sense of belonging for all our employees. Visit our Inclusion & Diversity page.
   

  

**Create a Future For Our People That Focuses On**
* Expanding your thinking
* Experimenting courageously
* Learning and pivoting


 Inspire greatness in our people by
   

  

* Empowering every voice
* Encouraging boldness
* Celebrating progress


 Accelerate the impact of our people by
   

  

* Amazing the client
* Prioritizing what matters
* Acting as one


**Learn more**
 Interested in knowing what’s going on inside Avanade? Check out our blogs:
   

  

* Avanade Insights That Matter
* Inside Avanade – explore what life is like workin
